class Hypercube(Shape):
    def __init__(
        self,
        lower: tuple[float, ...] | list[float] | Array,
        upper: tuple[float, ...] | list[float] | Array,
        *,
        axis_names: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
        marginals: tuple[pinnjax.MarginalSpec, ...] | None = None,
        evaluator: Callable | Sequence[Callable] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()

        self.lower = jnp.asarray(lower, dtype=config.get_dtype())
        self.upper = jnp.asarray(upper, dtype=config.get_dtype())
        self.evaluator = evaluator
        self.evaluated_values = None

        if self.lower.shape != self.upper.shape:
            raise ValueError(
                f"lower and upper must have the same length, "
                f"got {self.lower.shape} and {self.upper.shape}."
            )

        if jnp.any(self.upper <= self.lower):
            raise ValueError("Each upper bound must be strictly greater than lower.")

        k = int(self.lower.shape[0])
        self.spatial_dims = k
        self.dims = k
        self.times = None

        if axis_names is None:
            self.axis_names = tuple(f"mu{i}" for i in range(k))
        else:
            if len(axis_names) != k:
                raise ValueError(f"axis_names length must be {k}")
            self.axis_names = tuple(axis_names)

        if marginals is None:
            self.marginals = tuple(
                _uniform_on_interval(
                    (float(self.lower[i]), float(self.upper[i])),
                )
                for i in range(k)
            )
        else:
            if len(marginals) != k:
                raise ValueError(f"marginals length must be {k}, got {len(marginals)}")
            self.marginals = tuple(marginals)

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        raise NotImplementedError("Hypercube.draw is not implemented.")

    @property
    def domain(self) -> pinnjax.Domain:
        return pinnjax.Domain(
            min=tuple(float(x) for x in self.lower.tolist()),
            max=tuple(float(x) for x in self.upper.tolist()),
            axis_names=self.axis_names,
        )

    def bounds(self) -> tuple[Array, Array]:
        return self.lower, self.upper

    def transform(self, unit_samples: Array) -> Array:
        u = jnp.asarray(unit_samples, dtype=config.get_dtype())
        u_np = np.asarray(u)

        cols = [
            _transform_axis(u_np[..., i], self.marginals[i]) for i in range(self.dims)
        ]
        return jnp.asarray(np.stack(cols, axis=-1), dtype=config.get_dtype())

    def measure(self) -> Array:
        return jnp.prod(self.upper - self.lower)

    def estimate_nsamples(self, res: float) -> int:
        edges = self.upper - self.lower
        per_axis = jnp.maximum(jnp.round(edges / res), 2)
        return int(jnp.prod(per_axis))

    def sample(
        self,
        method: pinnjax.SamplingMethod,
        sampling_value: float | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Array, int]:
        self.samples, self.n_points = super().sample(method, sampling_value)

        if self.evaluator is not None:
            self.evaluated_values = self.evaluate(self.evaluator, overwrite=True)

        return self.samples, self.n_points

    def evaluate(
        self, evaluator: Callable | Sequence[Callable], *, overwrite: bool = False
    ):
        if self.samples is None:
            raise ValueError("Shape must first be sampled prior to evaluation.")

        evaluators = (evaluator,) if callable(evaluator) else tuple(evaluator)
        if len(evaluators) == 0:
            raise ValueError("evaluator sequence must contain at least one callable.")
        if not all(callable(fn) for fn in evaluators):
            raise TypeError("All evaluators must be callable.")

        values = [
            jnp.asarray(jax.vmap(fn)(self.samples), dtype=config.get_dtype())
            for fn in evaluators
        ]

        if len(values) == 1:
            out = values[0]
        else:
            out = jnp.stack(values, axis=0)

        if overwrite:
            self.evaluated_values = out

        return out

    @classmethod
    def from_domain(
        cls,

def __init__(
    self,
    lower: tuple[float, ...] | list[float] | Array,
    upper: tuple[float, ...] | list[float] | Array,
    *,
    axis_names: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
    marginals: tuple[pinnjax.MarginalSpec, ...] | None = None,
    evaluator: Callable | Sequence[Callable] | None = None,
) -> None:
    super().__init__()

    self.lower = jnp.asarray(lower, dtype=config.get_dtype())
    self.upper = jnp.asarray(upper, dtype=config.get_dtype())
    self.evaluator = evaluator
    self.evaluated_values = None

    if self.lower.shape != self.upper.shape:
        raise ValueError(
            f"lower and upper must have the same length, "
            f"got {self.lower.shape} and {self.upper.shape}."
        )

    if jnp.any(self.upper <= self.lower):
        raise ValueError("Each upper bound must be strictly greater than lower.")

    k = int(self.lower.shape[0])
    self.spatial_dims = k
    self.dims = k
    self.times = None

    if axis_names is None:
        self.axis_names = tuple(f"mu{i}" for i in range(k))
    else:
        if len(axis_names) != k:
            raise ValueError(f"axis_names length must be {k}")
        self.axis_names = tuple(axis_names)

    if marginals is None:
        self.marginals = tuple(
            _uniform_on_interval(
                (float(self.lower[i]), float(self.upper[i])),
            )
            for i in range(k)
        )
    else:
        if len(marginals) != k:
            raise ValueError(f"marginals length must be {k}, got {len(marginals)}")
        self.marginals = tuple(marginals)

def estimate_nsamples(self, res: float) -> int:
    edges = self.upper - self.lower
    per_axis = jnp.maximum(jnp.round(edges / res), 2)
    return int(jnp.prod(per_axis))

def evaluate(
    self, evaluator: Callable | Sequence[Callable], *, overwrite: bool = False
):
    if self.samples is None:
        raise ValueError("Shape must first be sampled prior to evaluation.")

    evaluators = (evaluator,) if callable(evaluator) else tuple(evaluator)
    if len(evaluators) == 0:
        raise ValueError("evaluator sequence must contain at least one callable.")
    if not all(callable(fn) for fn in evaluators):
        raise TypeError("All evaluators must be callable.")

    values = [
        jnp.asarray(jax.vmap(fn)(self.samples), dtype=config.get_dtype())
        for fn in evaluators
    ]

    if len(values) == 1:
        out = values[0]
    else:
        out = jnp.stack(values, axis=0)

    if overwrite:
        self.evaluated_values = out

    return out

def sample(
    self,
    method: pinnjax.SamplingMethod,
    sampling_value: float | None = None,
) -> tuple[Array, int]:

class DataShape(Shape, ABC):
    been_split: bool = False

    train_indices: Array
    train_inputs: Array
    train_outputs: Array

    test_indices: Array
    test_inputs: Array
    test_outputs: Array

    _shape: dict[str, tuple[int, ...]] | None = None

    validation_inputs: Array | None = None
    validation_outputs: Array | None = None
    _validation_indices: Array | None = None
    _full_inputs: Array | None = None
    _full_outputs: Array | None = None

    def __init__(
        self,
        inputs: Array,
        outputs: Array,
        *,
        indices: Array | Sequence[int] | None = None,
        portion: float = 1.0,
        materialize_validation_from_portion: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()

        inputs = jnp.asarray(inputs, dtype=config.get_dtype())
        outputs = jnp.asarray(outputs, dtype=config.get_dtype())

        if indices is None:
            indices = jnp.asarray(
                pinnjax.index_shuffle(len(inputs), portion=portion),
                dtype=int,
            )
        else:
            if not isinstance(indices, Array):
                if not isinstance(indices, Sequence):
                    msg = f"'indices' must be a Sequence. Got {type(indices).__name__}"
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise TypeError(msg)
                indices = jnp.asarray(indices, dtype=int)

        indices = jnp.sort(indices)
        n_full = int(inputs.shape[0])

        used = jnp.zeros(n_full, dtype=bool)
        used = used.at[indices].set(True)
        validation_indices = jnp.sort(jnp.where(~used)[0])

        self.validation_inputs = None
        self.validation_outputs = None
        self._validation_indices = None
        self._full_inputs = None
        self._full_outputs = None

        if validation_indices.size > 0:
            if materialize_validation_from_portion:
                self.validation_inputs = inputs[validation_indices]
                self.validation_outputs = outputs[validation_indices]
            else:
                self._validation_indices = validation_indices
                self._full_inputs = inputs
                self._full_outputs = outputs

        self.inputs = inputs[indices]
        self.outputs = outputs[indices]
        self.indices = indices

        if len(self.inputs) == len(self.outputs):
            self.num_data = len(self.inputs)
        else:
            msg = (
                f"Length of Inputs: {len(self.inputs)} and "
                f"Length of Outputs: {len(self.outputs)} must be equal."
            )
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

    def materialize_validation_from_portion(self) -> None:
        """Copy deferred held-out rows into ``validation_inputs`` / ``validation_outputs``.

        Only applies when the shape was built with ``portion < 1.0`` and
        ``materialize_validation_from_portion=False``, so row indices were set aside
        at construction. Calling this again after validation is already filled is a
        no-op. If no rows were ever held out (e.g. ``portion=1.0``), there is nothing
        to copy; logs a warning and returns.
        """
        if self.validation_inputs is not None:
            return
        if self._validation_indices is None or self._validation_indices.size == 0:
            config.LOGGER.warning(
                "All DATA was used in training/testing. Use a portion less than 1.0.",
            )
            return
        assert self._full_inputs is not None and self._full_outputs is not None
        self.validation_inputs = self._full_inputs[self._validation_indices]
        self.validation_outputs = self._full_outputs[self._validation_indices]
        self._validation_indices = None
        self._full_inputs = None
        self._full_outputs = None

    def clone(self, *, copy_split: bool = True) -> DataShape:
        # Pass identity indices so `inputs`/`outputs` are already the working rows
        # (global `self.indices` are not valid row picks into the subset tensor).
        n = len(self.inputs)
        ds = DataShape(
            self.inputs,
            self.outputs,
            indices=jnp.arange(n, dtype=int),
            portion=1.0,
            materialize_validation_from_portion=True,
        )
        ds.validation_inputs = self.validation_inputs
        ds.validation_outputs = self.validation_outputs
        if self._validation_indices is not None:
            ds._validation_indices = self._validation_indices
            ds._full_inputs = self._full_inputs
            ds._full_outputs = self._full_outputs
        if copy_split and self.been_split:
            ds.train_indices = self.train_indices
            ds.test_indices = self.test_indices
            ds.train_inputs = self.train_inputs
            ds.test_inputs = self.test_inputs
            ds.train_outputs = self.train_outputs
            ds.test_outputs = self.test_outputs
            ds.samples = self.samples
            ds.n_points = self.n_points
            ds.been_split = True
        return ds

    @classmethod
    def from_files(
        cls,
        path: Path | str,
        *,
        portion: float = 1.0,
        input_folder_name: str = "input",
        output_folder_name: str = "output",
        mat_key: str = "groundTruth",
        resort: bool = False,
    ) -> DataShape:
        input_files, output_files, indices = _load_data_files(
            path,
            input_folder_name=input_folder_name,
            output_folder_name=output_folder_name,
            portion=portion,
        )
        inputs, outputs = _files_to_jax_arrays(
            input_files,
            output_files,
            mat_key=mat_key,
            resort=resort,
        )

        # portion = 1.0 because it would've already been split.
        return cls(inputs, outputs, portion=1.0, indices=indices)

    @classmethod
    def from_table(
        cls,
        table: str | Path | pl.DataFrame,
        *,
        input_columns: str | int | Sequence[str] | Sequence[int],
        output_columns: str | int | Sequence[str] | Sequence[int],
        portion: float = 1.0,
        drop_nulls: bool = True,
        materialize_validation_from_portion: bool = True,
    ) -> "DataShape":
        def _normalize_columns(
            spec: str | int | Sequence[str] | Sequence[int],
            available: Sequence[str],
            *,
            arg_name: str,
        ) -> list[str]:
            cols = list(available)

            if isinstance(spec, (str, int)):
                items = [spec]
            elif isinstance(spec, Sequence):
                if len(spec) == 0:
                    raise ValueError(f"`{arg_name}` cannot be empty.")
                items = list(spec)
            else:
                raise TypeError(f"`{arg_name}` has invalid type: {type(spec).__name__}")

            has_str = any(isinstance(x, str) for x in items)
            has_int = any(isinstance(x, int) for x in items)
            if has_str and has_int:
                raise TypeError(f"`{arg_name}` cannot mix str and int in one sequence.")

            if has_str:
                out = [str(x) for x in items]
                missing = [c for c in out if c not in cols]
                if missing:
                    raise ValueError(f"`{arg_name}` unknown columns: {missing}")
                return out

            out: list[str] = []
            for idx in items:
                if not isinstance(idx, int):
                    raise TypeError(f"`{arg_name}` must contain only str or only int.")
                if idx < 0 or idx >= len(cols):
                    raise IndexError(
                        f"`{arg_name}` index {idx} out of range [0, {len(cols) - 1}]"
                    )
                out.append(cols[idx])
            return out

        if isinstance(table, pl.DataFrame):
            df = table
        else:
            path = Path(table)
            if path.suffix.lower() != ".csv":
                raise ValueError(f"Expected .csv, got {path.suffix}")
            df = pl.read_csv(path)

        in_cols = _normalize_columns(
            input_columns, df.columns, arg_name="input_columns"
        )
        out_cols = _normalize_columns(
            output_columns, df.columns, arg_name="output_columns"
        )

        overlap = sorted(set(in_cols).intersection(out_cols))
        if overlap:
            raise ValueError(f"Input/output columns overlap: {overlap}")

        selected = in_cols + out_cols
        df = df.select(selected)
        if drop_nulls:
            df = df.drop_nulls(subset=selected)

        x = df.select(in_cols).to_numpy().astype(float)
        y = df.select(out_cols).to_numpy().astype(float)
        if y.ndim == 1:
            y = y[:, None]

        indices = None
        if portion != 1.0:
            indices = jnp.asarray(
                pinnjax.index_shuffle(len(x), portion=portion),
                dtype=int,
            )

        return cls(
            jnp.asarray(x, dtype=config.get_dtype()),
            jnp.asarray(y, dtype=config.get_dtype()),
            indices=indices,
            portion=1.0,
            materialize_validation_from_portion=materialize_validation_from_portion,
        )

    @property
    def shape(self, *, overwrite: bool = False):
        if self._shape is None or overwrite is True:
            self._shape = self._compute_shape()
        return self._shape

    def _compute_shape(self) -> dict[str, tuple[int, ...]]:
        return {
            "input": self._compute_input_shape(),
            "output": self._compute_output_shape(),
        }

    def _compute_input_shape(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
        if self.inputs is None:
            raise RuntimeError("inputs not set")
        return tuple(self.inputs.shape[1:])

    def _compute_output_shape(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
        if self.outputs is None:
            raise RuntimeError("outputs not set")
        return tuple(self.outputs.shape[1:])

    def _stratify_sort_indices(
        self,
        stratify_on: Literal["outputs", "inputs"],
        output_column: int,
    ) -> list[int]:
        """Row indices sorted ascending by stratification key (shared by stratified modes)."""
        if stratify_on == "outputs":
            y = jnp.asarray(self.outputs)
            if y.ndim == 1:
                key = y
            elif y.ndim == 2:
                if output_column < 0 or output_column >= y.shape[1]:
                    msg = (
                        f"`output_column` out of range for outputs shape {y.shape}. "
                        f"Got {output_column}."
                    )
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                key = y[:, output_column]
            else:
                msg = (
                    f"Unsupported outputs ndim={y.ndim} for stratification. "
                    "Expected 1D or 2D outputs."
                )
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
        else:
            x = jnp.asarray(self.inputs)
            if x.ndim != 2:
                msg = (
                    f"Unsupported inputs ndim={x.ndim} for stratification on inputs. "
                    "Expected 2D inputs."
                )
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            if output_column < 0 or output_column >= x.shape[1]:
                msg = (
                    f"`output_column` out of range for inputs shape {x.shape}. "
                    f"Got {output_column}."
                )
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            key = x[:, output_column]
        return list(map(int, jnp.argsort(key).tolist()))

    def test_train_split(
        self,
        split_percentage: float = 0.5,
        *,
        overwrite: bool = False,
        seed: int | None = None,  # default: config.get_seed() # 100
        mode: Literal["shuffle", "stratified", "stratified_kfold"] = "shuffle",
        stratified_assignment: Literal["random", "ordered"] = "random",
        consecutive_samples: int = 5,  # group size
        train_per_group: Optional[int] = 3,
        # if None: derived from split_percentage
        stratify_on: Literal["outputs", "inputs"] = "outputs",
        output_column: int = 0,  # if outputs is (N, k), which column to sort by.
        # stratified_kfold: requires consecutive_samples == n_folds; in each full block,
        # position j (0..n_folds-1) is test for fold j; partial tail block -> train only
        n_folds: int = 5,
        fold: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        if self.been_split is not True or overwrite is True:
            if overwrite:
                msg = "This DataShape was previously split. Overwriting."
                config.LOGGER.warning(msg)
            if split_percentage <= 0 or split_percentage >= 1:
                if mode != "stratified_kfold":
                    msg = (
                        "`split_percentage` must be between 0 and 1 (non-exclusive)."
                        f" Got {split_percentage}."
                    )
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)

            if seed is None:
                seed = pinnjax.config.get_seed()

            if mode == "shuffle":
                indices = pinnjax.index_shuffle(self.num_data, seed=seed)
                split = max(int(self.num_data * split_percentage), 1)
                self.train_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(indices[:split]), dtype=int)
                self.test_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(indices[split:]), dtype=int)
            elif mode == "stratified_kfold":
                if n_folds < 2:
                    msg = "`n_folds` must be >= 2 for stratified_kfold mode."
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                if fold < 0 or fold >= n_folds:
                    msg = f"`fold` must be in [0, n_folds). Got fold={fold}, n_folds={n_folds}."
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                if consecutive_samples < 2:
                    msg = (
                        "`consecutive_samples` must be >= 2 for stratified_kfold mode."
                    )
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                if consecutive_samples != n_folds:
                    msg = (
                        "`stratified_kfold` requires `consecutive_samples` == `n_folds` "
                        "so each ascending-life block assigns one sample per fold."
                    )
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                sorted_idx = self._stratify_sort_indices(stratify_on, output_column)
                train_idx: list[int] = []
                test_idx: list[int] = []
                for start in range(0, len(sorted_idx), consecutive_samples):
                    block = sorted_idx[start : start + consecutive_samples]
                    if len(block) < consecutive_samples:
                        train_idx.extend(block)
                        continue
                    for j, idx in enumerate(block):
                        if j == fold:
                            test_idx.append(idx)
                        else:
                            train_idx.append(idx)
                self.train_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(train_idx), dtype=int)
                self.test_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(test_idx), dtype=int)
            elif mode == "stratified":
                if stratified_assignment not in ("random", "ordered"):
                    msg = (
                        "`stratified_assignment` must be 'random' or 'ordered'. "
                        f"Got {stratified_assignment!r}."
                    )
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                if consecutive_samples < 2:
                    msg = "`consecutive_samples` must be >= 2 for stratified mode."
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                sorted_idx = self._stratify_sort_indices(stratify_on, output_column)
                if train_per_group is None:
                    tpg = int(round(consecutive_samples * split_percentage))
                else:
                    tpg = int(train_per_group)
                tpg = max(1, min(tpg, consecutive_samples - 1))
                train_idx = []
                test_idx = []
                for start in range(0, len(sorted_idx), consecutive_samples):
                    block = sorted_idx[start : start + consecutive_samples]
                    if len(block) == 1:
                        train_idx.extend(block)
                        continue
                    if stratified_assignment == "random":
                        random.Random(seed).shuffle(block)
                    k = min(max(1, tpg), len(block) - 1)
                    train_idx.extend(block[:k])
                    test_idx.extend(block[k:])
                self.train_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(train_idx), dtype=int)
                self.test_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(test_idx), dtype=int)
            else:
                msg = (
                    f"Invalid split mode: {mode}. "
                    "Use 'shuffle', 'stratified', or 'stratified_kfold'."
                )
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            self.train_inputs, self.test_inputs = (
                self.inputs[self.train_indices],
                self.inputs[self.test_indices],
            )
            self.train_outputs, self.test_outputs = (
                self.outputs[self.train_indices],
                self.outputs[self.test_indices],
            )
            self.samples = self.train_inputs
            self.n_points = len(self.train_inputs)
            self.been_split = True
        else:
            msg = (
                "This DataShape has already been split into test/train. "
                "Continuing without making changes"
            )
            config.LOGGER.warning(msg)

    def test_train_loaders(
        self,
        batch_size: int = 32,
        shuffle: bool = True,
        pin_memory: bool = False,
        drop_last: bool = False,
        device: str | torch.device | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[PyTorchDataLoader, PyTorchDataLoader]:
        if not self.been_split:
            raise RuntimeError("DataShape must be split first (call test_train_split)")
        train_loader = self.to_data_loader(
            batch_size,
            shuffle,
            True,
            pin_memory,
            drop_last,
            device,
        )
        test_loader = self.to_data_loader(
            batch_size,
            False,
            False,
            pin_memory,
            drop_last,
            device,
        )
        return train_loader, test_loader

    def to_data_loader(
        self,
        batch_size: int = 32,
        shuffle: bool = True,
        train: bool = True,
        pin_memory: bool = False,
        drop_last: bool = False,
        device: str | torch.device | None = None,
    ) -> PyTorchDataLoader:
        """Return a PyTorch DataLoader wrapping the JAX arrays (zero-copy)."""
        if not self.been_split:
            raise RuntimeError("DataShape must be split first (call test_train_split)")
        x = self.train_inputs if train else self.test_inputs
        y = self.train_outputs if train else self.test_outputs

        dataset = JAXDataset(x, y)
        loader = PyTorchDataLoader(
            dataset,
            batch_size=batch_size,
            shuffle=shuffle if train else False,
            pin_memory=pin_memory,
            drop_last=drop_last,
        )

        # Optional: move tensors to device on the fly
        if device is not None:
            for batch_idx, (bx, by) in enumerate(loader):
                loader.dataset.x[batch_idx] = bx.to(device)
                loader.dataset.y[batch_idx] = by.to(device)

        return loader

    def draw(
        self,
        data_index: int = 0,
        *,
        subplot_orientation: SubPlotOrientation = "horizontal",
        show_title: bool = False,
        show_captions: bool = True,
        show: bool = True,
        save: bool = False,
        save_location: str | Path | None = None,
        save_name: str | None = "comparison.pdf",
        resort: bool | None = None,
    ):
        if data_index < 0 or data_index >= len(self.inputs):
            raise IndexError(
                f"Index {data_index} out of range for dataset length {len(self.inputs)}",
            )
        _draw_arrays(
            self.inputs,
            self.outputs,
            data_index=data_index,
            subplot_orientation=subplot_orientation,
            show_title=show_title,
            show_captions=show_captions,
            show=show,
            save=save,
            save_location=save_location,
            save_name=save_name,
            resort=resort,
        )

def __init__(
    self,
    inputs: Array,
    outputs: Array,
    *,
    indices: Array | Sequence[int] | None = None,
    portion: float = 1.0,
    materialize_validation_from_portion: bool = True,
) -> None:
    super().__init__()

    inputs = jnp.asarray(inputs, dtype=config.get_dtype())
    outputs = jnp.asarray(outputs, dtype=config.get_dtype())

    if indices is None:
        indices = jnp.asarray(
            pinnjax.index_shuffle(len(inputs), portion=portion),
            dtype=int,
        )
    else:
        if not isinstance(indices, Array):
            if not isinstance(indices, Sequence):
                msg = f"'indices' must be a Sequence. Got {type(indices).__name__}"
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise TypeError(msg)
            indices = jnp.asarray(indices, dtype=int)

    indices = jnp.sort(indices)
    n_full = int(inputs.shape[0])

    used = jnp.zeros(n_full, dtype=bool)
    used = used.at[indices].set(True)
    validation_indices = jnp.sort(jnp.where(~used)[0])

    self.validation_inputs = None
    self.validation_outputs = None
    self._validation_indices = None
    self._full_inputs = None
    self._full_outputs = None

    if validation_indices.size > 0:
        if materialize_validation_from_portion:
            self.validation_inputs = inputs[validation_indices]
            self.validation_outputs = outputs[validation_indices]
        else:
            self._validation_indices = validation_indices
            self._full_inputs = inputs
            self._full_outputs = outputs

    self.inputs = inputs[indices]
    self.outputs = outputs[indices]
    self.indices = indices

    if len(self.inputs) == len(self.outputs):
        self.num_data = len(self.inputs)
    else:
        msg = (
            f"Length of Inputs: {len(self.inputs)} and "
            f"Length of Outputs: {len(self.outputs)} must be equal."
        )
        config.LOGGER.error(msg)
        raise ValueError(msg)

def clone(self, *, copy_split: bool = True) -> DataShape:
    # Pass identity indices so `inputs`/`outputs` are already the working rows
    # (global `self.indices` are not valid row picks into the subset tensor).
    n = len(self.inputs)
    ds = DataShape(
        self.inputs,
        self.outputs,
        indices=jnp.arange(n, dtype=int),
        portion=1.0,
        materialize_validation_from_portion=True,
    )
    ds.validation_inputs = self.validation_inputs
    ds.validation_outputs = self.validation_outputs
    if self._validation_indices is not None:
        ds._validation_indices = self._validation_indices
        ds._full_inputs = self._full_inputs
        ds._full_outputs = self._full_outputs
    if copy_split and self.been_split:
        ds.train_indices = self.train_indices
        ds.test_indices = self.test_indices
        ds.train_inputs = self.train_inputs
        ds.test_inputs = self.test_inputs
        ds.train_outputs = self.train_outputs
        ds.test_outputs = self.test_outputs
        ds.samples = self.samples
        ds.n_points = self.n_points
        ds.been_split = True
    return ds

def from_files(

@classmethod
def from_table(
    cls,
    table: str | Path | pl.DataFrame,
    *,
    input_columns: str | int | Sequence[str] | Sequence[int],
    output_columns: str | int | Sequence[str] | Sequence[int],
    portion: float = 1.0,
    drop_nulls: bool = True,
    materialize_validation_from_portion: bool = True,
) -> "DataShape":
    def _normalize_columns(
        spec: str | int | Sequence[str] | Sequence[int],
        available: Sequence[str],
        *,
        arg_name: str,
    ) -> list[str]:
        cols = list(available)

        if isinstance(spec, (str, int)):
            items = [spec]
        elif isinstance(spec, Sequence):
            if len(spec) == 0:
                raise ValueError(f"`{arg_name}` cannot be empty.")
            items = list(spec)
        else:
            raise TypeError(f"`{arg_name}` has invalid type: {type(spec).__name__}")

        has_str = any(isinstance(x, str) for x in items)
        has_int = any(isinstance(x, int) for x in items)
        if has_str and has_int:
            raise TypeError(f"`{arg_name}` cannot mix str and int in one sequence.")

        if has_str:
            out = [str(x) for x in items]
            missing = [c for c in out if c not in cols]
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"`{arg_name}` unknown columns: {missing}")
            return out

        out: list[str] = []
        for idx in items:
            if not isinstance(idx, int):
                raise TypeError(f"`{arg_name}` must contain only str or only int.")
            if idx < 0 or idx >= len(cols):
                raise IndexError(
                    f"`{arg_name}` index {idx} out of range [0, {len(cols) - 1}]"
                )
            out.append(cols[idx])
        return out

    if isinstance(table, pl.DataFrame):
        df = table
    else:
        path = Path(table)
        if path.suffix.lower() != ".csv":
            raise ValueError(f"Expected .csv, got {path.suffix}")
        df = pl.read_csv(path)

    in_cols = _normalize_columns(
        input_columns, df.columns, arg_name="input_columns"
    )
    out_cols = _normalize_columns(
        output_columns, df.columns, arg_name="output_columns"
    )

    overlap = sorted(set(in_cols).intersection(out_cols))
    if overlap:
        raise ValueError(f"Input/output columns overlap: {overlap}")

    selected = in_cols + out_cols
    df = df.select(selected)
    if drop_nulls:
        df = df.drop_nulls(subset=selected)

    x = df.select(in_cols).to_numpy().astype(float)
    y = df.select(out_cols).to_numpy().astype(float)
    if y.ndim == 1:
        y = y[:, None]

    indices = None
    if portion != 1.0:
        indices = jnp.asarray(
            pinnjax.index_shuffle(len(x), portion=portion),
            dtype=int,
        )

    return cls(
        jnp.asarray(x, dtype=config.get_dtype()),
        jnp.asarray(y, dtype=config.get_dtype()),
        indices=indices,
        portion=1.0,
        materialize_validation_from_portion=materialize_validation_from_portion,
    )

Only applies when the shape was built with portion < 1.0 and materialize_validation_from_portion=False, so row indices were set aside at construction. Calling this again after validation is already filled is a no-op. If no rows were ever held out (e.g. portion=1.0), there is nothing to copy; logs a warning and returns.

def materialize_validation_from_portion(self) -> None:
    """Copy deferred held-out rows into ``validation_inputs`` / ``validation_outputs``.

    Only applies when the shape was built with ``portion < 1.0`` and
    ``materialize_validation_from_portion=False``, so row indices were set aside
    at construction. Calling this again after validation is already filled is a
    no-op. If no rows were ever held out (e.g. ``portion=1.0``), there is nothing
    to copy; logs a warning and returns.
    """
    if self.validation_inputs is not None:
        return
    if self._validation_indices is None or self._validation_indices.size == 0:
        config.LOGGER.warning(
            "All DATA was used in training/testing. Use a portion less than 1.0.",
        )
        return
    assert self._full_inputs is not None and self._full_outputs is not None
    self.validation_inputs = self._full_inputs[self._validation_indices]
    self.validation_outputs = self._full_outputs[self._validation_indices]
    self._validation_indices = None
    self._full_inputs = None
    self._full_outputs = None

def test_train_split(
    self,
    split_percentage: float = 0.5,
    *,
    overwrite: bool = False,
    seed: int | None = None,  # default: config.get_seed() # 100
    mode: Literal["shuffle", "stratified", "stratified_kfold"] = "shuffle",
    stratified_assignment: Literal["random", "ordered"] = "random",
    consecutive_samples: int = 5,  # group size
    train_per_group: Optional[int] = 3,
    # if None: derived from split_percentage
    stratify_on: Literal["outputs", "inputs"] = "outputs",
    output_column: int = 0,  # if outputs is (N, k), which column to sort by.
    # stratified_kfold: requires consecutive_samples == n_folds; in each full block,
    # position j (0..n_folds-1) is test for fold j; partial tail block -> train only
    n_folds: int = 5,
    fold: int = 0,
) -> None:
    if self.been_split is not True or overwrite is True:
        if overwrite:
            msg = "This DataShape was previously split. Overwriting."
            config.LOGGER.warning(msg)
        if split_percentage <= 0 or split_percentage >= 1:
            if mode != "stratified_kfold":
                msg = (
                    "`split_percentage` must be between 0 and 1 (non-exclusive)."
                    f" Got {split_percentage}."
                )
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)

        if seed is None:
            seed = pinnjax.config.get_seed()

        if mode == "shuffle":
            indices = pinnjax.index_shuffle(self.num_data, seed=seed)
            split = max(int(self.num_data * split_percentage), 1)
            self.train_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(indices[:split]), dtype=int)
            self.test_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(indices[split:]), dtype=int)
        elif mode == "stratified_kfold":
            if n_folds < 2:
                msg = "`n_folds` must be >= 2 for stratified_kfold mode."
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            if fold < 0 or fold >= n_folds:
                msg = f"`fold` must be in [0, n_folds). Got fold={fold}, n_folds={n_folds}."
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            if consecutive_samples < 2:
                msg = (
                    "`consecutive_samples` must be >= 2 for stratified_kfold mode."
                )
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            if consecutive_samples != n_folds:
                msg = (
                    "`stratified_kfold` requires `consecutive_samples` == `n_folds` "
                    "so each ascending-life block assigns one sample per fold."
                )
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            sorted_idx = self._stratify_sort_indices(stratify_on, output_column)
            train_idx: list[int] = []
            test_idx: list[int] = []
            for start in range(0, len(sorted_idx), consecutive_samples):
                block = sorted_idx[start : start + consecutive_samples]
                if len(block) < consecutive_samples:
                    train_idx.extend(block)
                    continue
                for j, idx in enumerate(block):
                    if j == fold:
                        test_idx.append(idx)
                    else:
                        train_idx.append(idx)
            self.train_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(train_idx), dtype=int)
            self.test_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(test_idx), dtype=int)
        elif mode == "stratified":
            if stratified_assignment not in ("random", "ordered"):
                msg = (
                    "`stratified_assignment` must be 'random' or 'ordered'. "
                    f"Got {stratified_assignment!r}."
                )
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            if consecutive_samples < 2:
                msg = "`consecutive_samples` must be >= 2 for stratified mode."
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            sorted_idx = self._stratify_sort_indices(stratify_on, output_column)
            if train_per_group is None:
                tpg = int(round(consecutive_samples * split_percentage))
            else:
                tpg = int(train_per_group)
            tpg = max(1, min(tpg, consecutive_samples - 1))
            train_idx = []
            test_idx = []
            for start in range(0, len(sorted_idx), consecutive_samples):
                block = sorted_idx[start : start + consecutive_samples]
                if len(block) == 1:
                    train_idx.extend(block)
                    continue
                if stratified_assignment == "random":
                    random.Random(seed).shuffle(block)
                k = min(max(1, tpg), len(block) - 1)
                train_idx.extend(block[:k])
                test_idx.extend(block[k:])
            self.train_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(train_idx), dtype=int)
            self.test_indices = jnp.asarray(sorted(test_idx), dtype=int)
        else:
            msg = (
                f"Invalid split mode: {mode}. "
                "Use 'shuffle', 'stratified', or 'stratified_kfold'."
            )
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self.train_inputs, self.test_inputs = (
            self.inputs[self.train_indices],
            self.inputs[self.test_indices],
        )
        self.train_outputs, self.test_outputs = (
            self.outputs[self.train_indices],
            self.outputs[self.test_indices],
        )
        self.samples = self.train_inputs
        self.n_points = len(self.train_inputs)
        self.been_split = True
    else:
        msg = (
            "This DataShape has already been split into test/train. "
            "Continuing without making changes"
        )
        config.LOGGER.warning(msg)

def to_data_loader(
    self,
    batch_size: int = 32,
    shuffle: bool = True,
    train: bool = True,
    pin_memory: bool = False,
    drop_last: bool = False,
    device: str | torch.device | None = None,
) -> PyTorchDataLoader:
    """Return a PyTorch DataLoader wrapping the JAX arrays (zero-copy)."""
    if not self.been_split:
        raise RuntimeError("DataShape must be split first (call test_train_split)")
    x = self.train_inputs if train else self.test_inputs
    y = self.train_outputs if train else self.test_outputs

    dataset = JAXDataset(x, y)
    loader = PyTorchDataLoader(
        dataset,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        shuffle=shuffle if train else False,
        pin_memory=pin_memory,
        drop_last=drop_last,
    )

    # Optional: move tensors to device on the fly
    if device is not None:
        for batch_idx, (bx, by) in enumerate(loader):
            loader.dataset.x[batch_idx] = bx.to(device)
            loader.dataset.y[batch_idx] = by.to(device)

    return loader

        self.kinds_type: tuple[int, ...] = ()
        self.labels_class: tuple[str, ...] = ()
        self.labels_type: tuple[str, ...] = ()
        self.loss_dictionary = {}
        self.evaluation_dictionary = {}
        self.final_loss_dictionary = {}
        self.best_epoch: int = 0
        self.last_epoch: int = 0
        self.loss_weights: Iterable = []

        self.n_class: int = 0
        self.n_type: int = 0

    def assign_residuals(
        self,
        residuals: pinnjax.Residual | list[pinnjax.Residual],
        *,
        class_map: dict | None = None,
        type_map: dict | None = None,
        labels_class: list | None = None,
        labels_type: list | None = None,
        kinds_class: list | None = None,
        kinds_type: list | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if isinstance(residuals, pinnjax.Residual):
            residuals = [residuals] * len(self.shapes)

        if len(residuals) != len(self.shapes):
            msg = "Length of Residuals must EQUAL length of Shapes"
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise config.InputError(msg)

        if class_map is None or type_map is None:
            class_map, type_map = {}, {}
        if labels_class is None or labels_type is None:
            labels_class, labels_type = [], []
        if kinds_class is None or kinds_type is None:
            kinds_class, kinds_type = [], []

        for _i, (shape, residual) in enumerate(
            zip(self.shapes, residuals, strict=True),
        ):
            if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
                shape.assign_residuals(
                    residual,
                    class_map=class_map,
                    type_map=type_map,
                    labels_class=labels_class,
                    labels_type=labels_type,
                    kinds_class=kinds_class,
                    kinds_type=kinds_type,
                )
                class_map, type_map = shape.class_map, shape.type_map
                labels_class, labels_type = shape.labels_class, shape.labels_type
                kinds_class, kinds_type = shape.kinds_class, shape.kinds_type
            else:
                shape.set_residual(residual)

                # class-level tag (exact residual class)
                cls = residual.__class__
                if cls not in class_map:
                    class_map[cls] = len(class_map)
                    labels_class.append(cls.__name__)
                kinds_class.append(class_map[cls])

                # type-level tag (overarching category)
                if isinstance(residual, pinnjax.BoundaryCondition):
                    type_cls = pinnjax.BoundaryCondition
                elif isinstance(residual, pinnjax.PartialDifferentialEquation):
                    type_cls = pinnjax.PartialDifferentialEquation
                elif isinstance(residual, pinnjax.InitialCondition):
                    type_cls = pinnjax.InitialCondition
                elif isinstance(residual, pinnjax.DataResidual):
                    type_cls = pinnjax.DataResidual
                else:
                    msg = f"Unsupported residual type: {type(residual)}"
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise TypeError(msg)

                if type_cls not in type_map:
                    type_map[type_cls] = len(type_map)
                    labels_type.append(type_cls.__name__)
                kinds_type.append(type_map[type_cls])

        self.class_map = class_map
        self.type_map = type_map
        self.kinds_class = tuple(kinds_class)
        self.kinds_type = tuple(kinds_type)
        self.labels_class = tuple(labels_class)
        self.labels_type = tuple(labels_type)

        self.n_class = int(max(self.kinds_class) + 1) if self.kinds_class else 0
        self.n_type = int(max(self.kinds_type) + 1) if self.kinds_type else 0

        if not self.loss_dictionary:
            self.loss_dictionary = {
                "class": {lab: [] for lab in self.labels_class},
                "type": {lab: [] for lab in self.labels_type},
            }

    def print_samples(self) -> None:
        for i, s in enumerate(self.shapes):
            config.LOGGER.info(
                "Shape %d (%s): %d collocation points",
                i + 1,
                s.__class__.__name__,
                s.n_points,
            )

    def final_loss(self, *, overwrite: bool = False) -> dict:
        if not self.loss_dictionary:
            msg = "The Loss Dictionary not yet populated. Train the model first."
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        if self.final_loss_dictionary and overwrite is False:
            return self.final_loss_dictionary

        self.final_loss_dictionary = _final_loss(self.loss_dictionary)

        return self.final_loss_dictionary

    def assign_loss(
        self,
        loss: pinnjax.Loss | list[pinnjax.Loss],
    ) -> None:
        """Assign a loss to each of ``self.shapes`` (same idea as ``assign_residuals``).


        One loss is reused for every top-level shape and, recursively, for all
        descendants of a ``ComplexShape``. A list must have length
        ``len(self.shapes)`` — one loss per top-level shape; a nested ``ComplexShape``
        then broadcasts one loss to its children.

        """
        if isinstance(loss, pinnjax.Loss):
            losses = [loss] * len(self.shapes)
        else:
            losses = list(loss)
        if len(losses) != len(self.shapes):
            msg = (
                f"Length of losses must equal length of shapes: "
                f"got {len(losses)} losses for {len(self.shapes)} shapes."
            )
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)
        for shape, lf in zip(self.shapes, losses, strict=True):
            if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
                shape.assign_loss(lf)
            else:
                shape.set_loss(lf)

    def add_initial(self) -> None:
        config.LOGGER.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

        self,
        path: pinnjax.Path,
        radius: float | Iterable = 1.0,

    def samples(
        self,
        method: pinnjax.SamplingMethod,
        sampling_values: float | list[float] | None = None,
        *,
        overwrite: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        n_shapes = len(self.shapes)
        if sampling_values is None:
            sampling_values = [None] * n_shapes
        if isinstance(sampling_values, float | int):
            sampling_values = [sampling_values] * n_shapes

        if n_shapes != len(sampling_values):
            msg = (
                f"Number of Shapes: {n_shapes} does not equal "
                f"number of sampling_values: {sampling_values}"
            )
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        self.n_points = 0
        for shape, value in zip(self.shapes, sampling_values, strict=True):
            if isinstance(shape, pinnjax.ComplexShape):
                shape.samples(method, value)
                self.n_points += shape.n_points
            elif shape.n_points == 0 or overwrite is True:
                _, x = shape.sample(
                    method,
                    value,
                )  # sampled points are stored in the objects
                self.n_points += x
            else:
                config.LOGGER.warning("Shape already sampled.")

    def residual_and_losses_old(
        self,
        model: pinnjax.NeuralNetwork,
        ops: pinnjax.DifferentialOperators,
    ) -> tuple[Array, Array, Array]:
        """Backup of the original ``residual_and_losses`` (full samples only)."""

        samples_list = tuple(s.samples for s in self.shapes)

        # static callables:
        residual_functions = tuple(s.residual_function for s in self.shapes)
        loss_functions = tuple(
            (s.loss_function or pinnjax.ResidualMSError()) for s in self.shapes
        )

        kinds_class = jnp.asarray(self.kinds_class, dtype=jnp.int32)
        n_class = self.n_class
        kinds_type = jnp.asarray(self.kinds_type, dtype=jnp.int32)
        n_type = self.n_type

        total, by_class, by_type = _losses_kernel(
            samples_list=samples_list,
            residual_functions=residual_functions,
            loss_functions=loss_functions,
            kinds_class=kinds_class,
            kinds_type=kinds_type,
            n_class=n_class,
            n_type=n_type,
            ops=ops,
        )

        return total, by_class, by_type

    def residual_and_losses(
        self,
        model: pinnjax.NeuralNetwork,
        ops: pinnjax.DifferentialOperators,
        *,
        samples_list_override: Sequence[Array] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Array, Array, Array]:
        """Compute total loss and per-class / per-type vectors.

        Args:
            model: Network to evaluate.
            ops: Differential operators for ``model``.
            samples_list_override: If ``None``, each shape's full ``samples`` are used.
                Otherwise, a tuple of length ``len(self.shapes)`` with per-shape
                point arrays (e.g. mini-batches) aligned with ``self.shapes``.
        """

        if samples_list_override is None:
            samples_list = tuple(s.samples for s in self.shapes)
        else:
            if len(samples_list_override) != len(self.shapes):
                msg = (
                    f"samples_list_override must have length {len(self.shapes)}, "
                    f"got {len(samples_list_override)}."
                )
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)
            samples_list = tuple(samples_list_override)

        # static callables:
        residual_functions = tuple(s.residual_function for s in self.shapes)
        loss_functions = tuple(
            (s.loss_function or pinnjax.ResidualMSError()) for s in self.shapes
        )

        kinds_class = jnp.asarray(self.kinds_class, dtype=jnp.int32)
        n_class = self.n_class
        kinds_type = jnp.asarray(self.kinds_type, dtype=jnp.int32)
        n_type = self.n_type

        total, by_class, by_type = _losses_kernel(
            samples_list=samples_list,
            residual_functions=residual_functions,
            loss_functions=loss_functions,
            kinds_class=kinds_class,
            kinds_type=kinds_type,
            n_class=n_class,
            n_type=n_type,
            ops=ops,
        )

        return total, by_class, by_type

    def plot_loss(
        self,
        *,
        mode: str = "class",
        title: str | None = None,
        show_best_epoch: bool | None = True,
        show_grid: bool = True,
        show: bool = True,
        save: bool = False,
        save_location: Path | str | None = None,
        save_name: str | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        fig, ax = pinnjax.plot_loss(
            self.loss_dictionary or self.final_loss(),
            mode=mode,
            title=title,
            best_epoch=self.best_epoch if show_best_epoch else None,
            show_grid=show_grid,
            show=show,
            save=save,
            save_location=save_location,
            save_name=save_name,
        )

        return fig, ax

    def plot_evaluation(
        self,
        *,
        normalize: bool = False,
        scale: Literal["linear", "semilogy", "semilogx", "loglog"] = "linear",
        title: str | None = None,
        show_best_epoch: bool = True,
        show_grid: bool = True,
        show: bool = True,
        save: bool = True,
        save_location: str | Path | None = None,
        save_name: str | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        if self.evaluation_dictionary:
            fig, ax = pinnjax.plot_evaluation(
                self.evaluation_dictionary,
                normalize=normalize,
                scale=scale,
                best_epoch=self.best_epoch if show_best_epoch else None,
                title=title,
                show_grid=show_grid,
                show=show,
                save=save,
                save_location=save_location,
                save_name=save_name,
            )
        else:
            msg = "Evaluation dictionary must first be populated."
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        return fig, ax

    def unpack(self, *, flatten: bool = True) -> None:
        # The purpose of this function is unpack internal ComplexShapes
        # into a single ComplexShape.
        for _i, shape in enumerate(list(self.shapes)):
            if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
                self.shapes.remove(shape)
                if flatten:
                    valid, _shapes, _residual, _loss = shape.verify_repetition(
                        set_return=True,
                    )
                    if valid:
                        _shape = next(iter(_shapes), None)
                        if _shape is not None:
                            domain = shape.encompassing_domain()
                            obb = domain.to_obb()
                            flattened_shape = _shape(*obb, times=domain.times)
                            if _residual:
                                flattened_shape.set_residual(_residual)
                            if _loss:
                                flattened_shape.set_loss(_loss)
                            samples = []
                            n_points = 0
                            for s in shape.shapes:
                                if s.samples is not None:
                                    samples.append(s.samples)
                                    n_points += round(s.n_points)

                            if len(samples) > 0:
                                flattened_shape.samples = jnp.vstack(samples)
                            else:
                                flattened_shape.samples = None

                            flattened_shape.n_points = round(n_points)
                            self.shapes.append(flattened_shape)
                    else:
                        config.LOGGER.warning(
                            "Complex Shape Identified, but repetition not verified.",
                        )
                else:
                    for s in shape.shapes:
                        self.shapes.append(s)

    def encompassing_domain(self) -> pinnjax.SpatialDomain:
        # returns a SpatialDomain which encompasses all shapes.
        mins = []
        maxs = []
        for shape in self.shapes:
            bmin, bmax = shape.bounds()
            mins.append(bmin)
            maxs.append(bmax)

        mins = jnp.stack(mins)
        maxs = jnp.stack(maxs)

        # compute overall min/max per column
        mins = jnp.min(mins, axis=0)
        maxs = jnp.max(maxs, axis=0)

        if self.times is not None:
            return pinnjax.SpatialDomain(
                min=tuple(mins[:-1]),
                max=tuple(maxs[:-1]),
                times=self.times,
            )
        times = pinnjax.Time(min=mins[-1], max=maxs[-1], step=0.1)
        return pinnjax.SpatialDomain(
            min=tuple(mins[:-1]),
            max=tuple(maxs[:-1]),
            times=times,
        )

    def verify_repetition(
        self,
        *,
        set_return: bool = False,
    ) -> bool | tuple[bool, set, set, set]:
        shapes = set()
        residual = set()
        loss = set()
        for shape in self.shapes:
            shapes.add(type(shape))
            if shape.has_residual():
                residual.add(shape.residual_function)
            if shape.has_loss():
                loss.add(shape.loss_function)

        valid = all(len(s) <= 1 for s in (shapes, residual, loss))
        if set_return:
            return valid, shapes, residual, loss
        return valid

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 8),
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        # Determine if we need 2D or 3D plotting by checking the shapes
        needs_3d = any(
            (hasattr(shape, "spatial_dims") and shape.spatial_dims >= THREE_DIMENSIONAL)
            for shape in self.shapes
        )

        # Create appropriate axes if not provided
        if fig is None or ax is None:
            fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
            if needs_3d:
                ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")
            else:
                ax = fig.add_subplot(111)

        # Draw each shape
        for shape in self.shapes:
            if hasattr(shape, "draw"):
                try:
                    fig, ax = shape.draw(
                        show_normals=show_normals,
                        normal_scale=normal_scale,
                        fig=fig,
                        ax=ax,
                        show=False,
                    )
                except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as e:
                    config.LOGGER.warning(
                        "Could not draw shape %s: %s",
                        type(shape).__name__,
                        e,
                    )

        # Set appropriate properties based on 2D vs 3D
        if needs_3d:
            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.set_zlabel("Z")
            ax.set_box_aspect([1, 1, 1])
        else:
            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.grid(True)
            ax.set_aspect("equal")

        ax.set_title(f"Complex Shape: {len(self.shapes)} components")

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

def assign_residuals(
    self,
    residuals: pinnjax.Residual | list[pinnjax.Residual],
    *,
    class_map: dict | None = None,
    type_map: dict | None = None,
    labels_class: list | None = None,
    labels_type: list | None = None,
    kinds_class: list | None = None,
    kinds_type: list | None = None,
) -> None:
    if isinstance(residuals, pinnjax.Residual):
        residuals = [residuals] * len(self.shapes)

    if len(residuals) != len(self.shapes):
        msg = "Length of Residuals must EQUAL length of Shapes"
        config.LOGGER.error(msg)
        raise config.InputError(msg)

    if class_map is None or type_map is None:
        class_map, type_map = {}, {}
    if labels_class is None or labels_type is None:
        labels_class, labels_type = [], []
    if kinds_class is None or kinds_type is None:
        kinds_class, kinds_type = [], []

    for _i, (shape, residual) in enumerate(
        zip(self.shapes, residuals, strict=True),
    ):
        if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
            shape.assign_residuals(
                residual,
                class_map=class_map,
                type_map=type_map,
                labels_class=labels_class,
                labels_type=labels_type,
                kinds_class=kinds_class,
                kinds_type=kinds_type,
            )
            class_map, type_map = shape.class_map, shape.type_map
            labels_class, labels_type = shape.labels_class, shape.labels_type
            kinds_class, kinds_type = shape.kinds_class, shape.kinds_type
        else:
            shape.set_residual(residual)

            # class-level tag (exact residual class)
            cls = residual.__class__
            if cls not in class_map:
                class_map[cls] = len(class_map)
                labels_class.append(cls.__name__)
            kinds_class.append(class_map[cls])

            # type-level tag (overarching category)
            if isinstance(residual, pinnjax.BoundaryCondition):
                type_cls = pinnjax.BoundaryCondition
            elif isinstance(residual, pinnjax.PartialDifferentialEquation):
                type_cls = pinnjax.PartialDifferentialEquation
            elif isinstance(residual, pinnjax.InitialCondition):
                type_cls = pinnjax.InitialCondition
            elif isinstance(residual, pinnjax.DataResidual):
                type_cls = pinnjax.DataResidual
            else:
                msg = f"Unsupported residual type: {type(residual)}"
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise TypeError(msg)

            if type_cls not in type_map:
                type_map[type_cls] = len(type_map)
                labels_type.append(type_cls.__name__)
            kinds_type.append(type_map[type_cls])

    self.class_map = class_map
    self.type_map = type_map
    self.kinds_class = tuple(kinds_class)
    self.kinds_type = tuple(kinds_type)
    self.labels_class = tuple(labels_class)
    self.labels_type = tuple(labels_type)

    self.n_class = int(max(self.kinds_class) + 1) if self.kinds_class else 0
    self.n_type = int(max(self.kinds_type) + 1) if self.kinds_type else 0

    if not self.loss_dictionary:
        self.loss_dictionary = {
            "class": {lab: [] for lab in self.labels_class},
            "type": {lab: [] for lab in self.labels_type},
        }

    fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 8),
    show: bool = True,
) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
    # Determine if we need 2D or 3D plotting by checking the shapes
    needs_3d = any(
        (hasattr(shape, "spatial_dims") and shape.spatial_dims >= THREE_DIMENSIONAL)
        for shape in self.shapes
    )

    # Create appropriate axes if not provided
    if fig is None or ax is None:
        fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
        if needs_3d:
            ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")
        else:
            ax = fig.add_subplot(111)

    # Draw each shape
    for shape in self.shapes:
        if hasattr(shape, "draw"):
            try:
                fig, ax = shape.draw(
                    show_normals=show_normals,
                    normal_scale=normal_scale,
                    fig=fig,
                    ax=ax,
                    show=False,
                )
            except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as e:
                config.LOGGER.warning(
                    "Could not draw shape %s: %s",
                    type(shape).__name__,
                    e,
                )

    # Set appropriate properties based on 2D vs 3D
    if needs_3d:
        ax.set_xlabel("X")
        ax.set_ylabel("Y")
        ax.set_zlabel("Z")
        ax.set_box_aspect([1, 1, 1])
    else:
        ax.set_xlabel("X")
        ax.set_ylabel("Y")
        ax.grid(True)
        ax.set_aspect("equal")

    ax.set_title(f"Complex Shape: {len(self.shapes)} components")

    if show:
        plt.show()

    return fig, ax

def encompassing_domain(self) -> pinnjax.SpatialDomain:
    # returns a SpatialDomain which encompasses all shapes.
    mins = []
    maxs = []
    for shape in self.shapes:
        bmin, bmax = shape.bounds()
        mins.append(bmin)
        maxs.append(bmax)

    mins = jnp.stack(mins)
    maxs = jnp.stack(maxs)

    # compute overall min/max per column
    mins = jnp.min(mins, axis=0)
    maxs = jnp.max(maxs, axis=0)

    if self.times is not None:
        return pinnjax.SpatialDomain(
            min=tuple(mins[:-1]),
            max=tuple(maxs[:-1]),
            times=self.times,
        )
    times = pinnjax.Time(min=mins[-1], max=maxs[-1], step=0.1)
    return pinnjax.SpatialDomain(
        min=tuple(mins[:-1]),
        max=tuple(maxs[:-1]),
        times=times,
    )

def residual_and_losses(
    self,
    model: pinnjax.NeuralNetwork,
    ops: pinnjax.DifferentialOperators,
    *,
    samples_list_override: Sequence[Array] | None = None,
) -> tuple[Array, Array, Array]:
    """Compute total loss and per-class / per-type vectors.

    Args:
        model: Network to evaluate.
        ops: Differential operators for ``model``.
        samples_list_override: If ``None``, each shape's full ``samples`` are used.
            Otherwise, a tuple of length ``len(self.shapes)`` with per-shape
            point arrays (e.g. mini-batches) aligned with ``self.shapes``.
    """

    if samples_list_override is None:
        samples_list = tuple(s.samples for s in self.shapes)
    else:
        if len(samples_list_override) != len(self.shapes):
            msg = (
                f"samples_list_override must have length {len(self.shapes)}, "
                f"got {len(samples_list_override)}."
            )
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)
        samples_list = tuple(samples_list_override)

    # static callables:
    residual_functions = tuple(s.residual_function for s in self.shapes)
    loss_functions = tuple(
        (s.loss_function or pinnjax.ResidualMSError()) for s in self.shapes
    )

    kinds_class = jnp.asarray(self.kinds_class, dtype=jnp.int32)
    n_class = self.n_class
    kinds_type = jnp.asarray(self.kinds_type, dtype=jnp.int32)
    n_type = self.n_type

    total, by_class, by_type = _losses_kernel(
        samples_list=samples_list,
        residual_functions=residual_functions,
        loss_functions=loss_functions,
        kinds_class=kinds_class,
        kinds_type=kinds_type,
        n_class=n_class,
        n_type=n_type,
        ops=ops,
    )

    return total, by_class, by_type

def samples(
    self,
    method: pinnjax.SamplingMethod,
    sampling_values: float | list[float] | None = None,
    *,
    overwrite: bool = False,
) -> None:
    n_shapes = len(self.shapes)
    if sampling_values is None:
        sampling_values = [None] * n_shapes
    if isinstance(sampling_values, float | int):
        sampling_values = [sampling_values] * n_shapes

    if n_shapes != len(sampling_values):
        msg = (
            f"Number of Shapes: {n_shapes} does not equal "
            f"number of sampling_values: {sampling_values}"
        )
        config.LOGGER.error(msg)
        raise ValueError(msg)

    self.n_points = 0
    for shape, value in zip(self.shapes, sampling_values, strict=True):
        if isinstance(shape, pinnjax.ComplexShape):
            shape.samples(method, value)
            self.n_points += shape.n_points
        elif shape.n_points == 0 or overwrite is True:
            _, x = shape.sample(
                method,
                value,
            )  # sampled points are stored in the objects
            self.n_points += x
        else:
            config.LOGGER.warning("Shape already sampled.")

def unpack(self, *, flatten: bool = True) -> None:
    # The purpose of this function is unpack internal ComplexShapes
    # into a single ComplexShape.
    for _i, shape in enumerate(list(self.shapes)):
        if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
            self.shapes.remove(shape)
            if flatten:
                valid, _shapes, _residual, _loss = shape.verify_repetition(
                    set_return=True,
                )
                if valid:
                    _shape = next(iter(_shapes), None)
                    if _shape is not None:
                        domain = shape.encompassing_domain()
                        obb = domain.to_obb()
                        flattened_shape = _shape(*obb, times=domain.times)
                        if _residual:
                            flattened_shape.set_residual(_residual)
                        if _loss:
                            flattened_shape.set_loss(_loss)
                        samples = []
                        n_points = 0
                        for s in shape.shapes:
                            if s.samples is not None:
                                samples.append(s.samples)
                                n_points += round(s.n_points)

                        if len(samples) > 0:
                            flattened_shape.samples = jnp.vstack(samples)
                        else:
                            flattened_shape.samples = None

                        flattened_shape.n_points = round(n_points)
                        self.shapes.append(flattened_shape)
                else:
                    config.LOGGER.warning(
                        "Complex Shape Identified, but repetition not verified.",
                    )
            else:
                for s in shape.shapes:
                    self.shapes.append(s)

def verify_repetition(
    self,
    *,
    set_return: bool = False,
) -> bool | tuple[bool, set, set, set]:
    shapes = set()
    residual = set()
    loss = set()
    for shape in self.shapes:
        shapes.add(type(shape))
        if shape.has_residual():
            residual.add(shape.residual_function)
        if shape.has_loss():
            loss.add(shape.loss_function)

    valid = all(len(s) <= 1 for s in (shapes, residual, loss))
    if set_return:
        return valid, shapes, residual, loss
    return valid

class BoundedLine(ComplexShape, ABC):
    def __init__(
        self,
        origin: float
        | tuple[float]
        | tuple[float, float]
        | tuple[float, float, float]
        | Array,
        end: float
        | tuple[float]
        | tuple[float, float]
        | tuple[float, float, float]
        | Array,
        times: pinnjax.Time | float | None = None,
        *,
        initial: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        self.origin = jnp.atleast_1d(jnp.asarray(origin, dtype=config.get_dtype()))
        self.end = jnp.atleast_1d(jnp.asarray(end, dtype=config.get_dtype()))
        self.spatial_dims = self.origin.size
        self.dims = self.origin.size

        # Handle different time specifications
        if isinstance(times, float):
            # Single time instant
            self.single_time = float(times)
            self.times = None
            self.dims += 1
        elif isinstance(times, pinnjax.Time):
            # Time range
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = times
            self.tmin = times.min
            self.tmax = times.max
            self.tstep = times.step
            self.dims += 1
        else:
            # No time dimension
            self.single_time = None
            self.times = None
        line = Line(origin=origin, end=end, times=self.times)
        dot_a = Dot(a=origin, times=self.times)
        dot_b = Dot(a=end, times=self.times)
        shapes = [line, dot_a, dot_b]

        super().__init__(shapes, times=self.times)

        self.initials_set = False
        if initial:
            self.add_initial()

    def add_initial(self) -> None:
        if not self.initials_set:
            self.shapes.append(
                Line(origin=self.origin, end=self.end, times=self.times.min),
            )
            self.initials_set = True
            return
        config.LOGGER.warning(
            "Initial Domain has already been added to this ComplexShape.",
        )
        return

    def add_path_shape(
        self,
        path: pinnjax.Path,
        radius: float | Iterable = 1.0,
    ) -> None:
        config.LOGGER.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

    def show_samples(
        self,
        *,
        color: str = "dodgerblue",
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 8),
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        if fig is None or ax is None:
            if self.spatial_dims == THREE_DIMENSIONAL:
                fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
                ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")
            else:
                fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=fig_size)

        for shape in self.shapes:
            _samples = shape.samples[:, : self.spatial_dims]

            if self.spatial_dims == 1:
                _samples = jnp.column_stack(
                    [_samples[:, 0], jnp.zeros_like(_samples[:, 0])],
                )
                ax.scatter(*_samples.T, color=color, marker=",", s=2)

            elif self.spatial_dims in {TWO_DIMENSIONAL, THREE_DIMENSIONAL}:
                ax.scatter(*_samples.T, color=color, marker=",", s=2)

            else:
                msg = f"Unsupported spatial dimension: {self.spatial_dims}"
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_samples: bool = False,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 8),
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        if self.origin.size == 1:
            # 1D: draw on x-axis
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=fig_size)

            ax.plot([self.origin[0], self.end[0]], [0, 0], "b-")
            ax.scatter([self.origin[0], self.end[0]], [0, 0], c="red")
            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_yticks([])

        elif self.origin.size == TWO_DIMENSIONAL:
            # 2D line
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=fig_size)

            ax.plot(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                "b-",
            )
            ax.scatter(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                c="red",
            )
            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.set_aspect("equal")

        elif self.origin.size == THREE_DIMENSIONAL:
            # 3D line
            if fig is None or ax is None:
                fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
                ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

            ax.plot(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                [self.origin[2], self.end[2]],
                "b-",
            )
            ax.scatter(
                [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
                [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
                [self.origin[2], self.end[2]],
                c="red",
            )
            ax.set_xlabel("X")
            ax.set_ylabel("Y")
            ax.set_zlabel("Z")
            ax.set_box_aspect([1, 1, 1])

        else:
            msg = f"Unsupported dimension: {self.origin.size}"
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        if show_samples:
            fig, ax = self.show_samples(fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

        # 3D line
        if fig is None or ax is None:
            fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
            ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

        ax.plot(
            [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
            [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
            [self.origin[2], self.end[2]],
            "b-",

        ax.scatter(
            [self.origin[0], self.end[0]],
            [self.origin[1], self.end[1]],
            [self.origin[2], self.end[2]],

        ax.set_xlabel("X")
        ax.set_ylabel("Y")
        ax.set_zlabel("Z")

    return fig, ax
