class BoundedRectangle(ComplexShape, ABC):
    # TODO: Seems an issue with the last line made - and how it related to .measure().
    #   The edge = 0,0 so the jnp.linalg.norm(edge) = 0
    """A 2D rectangle with interior and 4 boundary lines - consistent with Rectangle."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        origin: tuple[float, float],
        edge1: tuple[float, float],
        edge2: tuple[float, float],
        *,
        times: pinnjax.Time | None = None,
        initial: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        # Create interior rectangle (same as normal Rectangle)
        interior = Rectangle(origin=origin, edge1=edge1, edge2=edge2, times=times)

        # Create 4 boundary lines using the same edge vectors
        # Bottom edge: origin to origin + edge1
        bottom_line = Line(
            origin=origin,
            end=(origin[0] + edge1[0], origin[1] + edge1[1]),
            times=times,
        )

        # Right edge: origin + edge1 to origin + edge1 + edge2
        right_start = (origin[0] + edge1[0], origin[1] + edge1[1])
        right_end = (origin[0] + edge1[0] + edge2[0], origin[1] + edge1[1] + edge2[1])
        right_line = Line(origin=right_start, end=right_end, times=times)

        # Top edge: origin + edge1 + edge2 to origin + edge2
        top_start = (origin[0] + edge1[0] + edge2[0], origin[1] + edge1[1] + edge2[1])
        top_end = (origin[0] + edge2[0], origin[1] + edge2[1])
        top_line = Line(origin=top_start, end=top_end, times=times)

        # Left edge: origin + edge2 to origin
        left_start = (origin[0] + edge2[0], origin[1] + edge2[1])
        left_line = Line(origin=left_start, end=origin, times=times)

        # Combine interior + boundaries
        shapes = [interior, bottom_line, right_line, top_line, left_line]

        super().__init__(shapes)

        self.initials_set = False
        if initial:
            self.add_initial()

        # Store references for easy access
        self.interior = interior
        self.bottom_line = bottom_line
        self.right_line = right_line
        self.top_line = top_line
        self.left_line = left_line

        # Store the original parameters for consistency
        self.origin = jnp.array(origin)
        self.edge1 = jnp.array(edge1)
        self.edge2 = jnp.array(edge2)
        self.times = times

        # Set correct outward normals manually
        self.bottom_line.normal = lambda: jnp.array([0.0, -1.0])  # Down
        self.right_line.normal = lambda: jnp.array([1.0, 0.0])  # Right
        self.top_line.normal = lambda: jnp.array([0.0, 1.0])  # Up
        self.left_line.normal = lambda: jnp.array([-1.0, 0.0])  # Left

    def add_initial(self) -> None:
        if not self.initials_set:
            self.shapes.append(
                Rectangle(
                    origin=self.origin,
                    edge1=self.edge1,
                    edge2=self.edge2,
                    times=self.times.min,
                ),
            )
            self.initials_set = True
            return
        config.LOGGER.warning(
            "Initial Domain has already been added to this ComplexShape.",
        )
        return

    def add_path_shape(
        self,
        path: pinnjax.Path,
        radius: float | Iterable = 1.0,
    ) -> None:
        # TODO(@mjryande): Implement additional Path shape for BoundedRectangle
        config.LOGGER.error("Not implemented.")
        raise NotImplementedError

    def show_samples(
        self,
        *,
        color: str = "dodgerblue",
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 8),
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        if fig is None or ax is None:
            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=fig_size)

        for shape in self.shapes:
            _samples = shape.samples
            ax.plot(
                _samples[:, 0],
                _samples[:, 1],
                color=color,
                linestyle="None",
                marker=".",
                markersize=1,
                zorder=-1,
            )

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        show_samples: bool = False,
        normal_scale: float = 1.0,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 8),
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        # TODO(@mjryande): Update draw() for Path Shape.
        if fig is None or ax is None:
            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=fig_size)  # Force 2D axes

        # Draw interior outline
        corners = jnp.stack(
            [
                self.origin,
                self.origin + self.edge1,
                self.origin + self.edge1 + self.edge2,
                self.origin + self.edge2,
                self.origin,
            ],
        )
        ax.plot(
            corners[:, 0],
            corners[:, 1],
            "k--",
            alpha=0.3,
            linewidth=2,
            label="Interior Domain",
        )

        # Draw boundary lines
        colors = ["blue", "red", "green", "orange"]
        labels = ["Bottom BC", "Right BC", "Top BC", "Left BC"]
        lines = [self.bottom_line, self.right_line, self.top_line, self.left_line]

        for line, color, label in zip(lines, colors, labels, strict=True):
            # Draw line
            ax.plot(
                [line.origin[0], line.end[0]],
                [line.origin[1], line.end[1]],
                color=color,
                linewidth=4,
                label=label,
                alpha=0.8,
            )

            # Draw normal
            if show_normals:
                midpoint = (line.origin + line.end) / 2
                try:
                    n = line.normal() * normal_scale
                    ax.arrow(
                        float(midpoint[0]),
                        float(midpoint[1]),
                        float(n[0]),
                        float(n[1]),
                        head_width=normal_scale * 0.1,
                        head_length=normal_scale * 0.1,
                        fc=color,
                        ec=color,
                        alpha=0.7,
                    )
                except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as e:
                    config.LOGGER.warning("Could not draw normal for %s: %s", label, e)

        if show_samples:
            fig, ax = self.show_samples(fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)

        ax.legend()
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
        ax.set_aspect("equal")
        ax.set_xlabel("X")
        ax.set_ylabel("Y")
        ax.set_title("Bounded Rectangle: Interior PDE + Boundary Conditions")

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

class BoundedBox(ComplexShape, ABC):
    def __init__(
        self,
        origin: tuple[float, float, float],
        edge1: tuple[float, float, float],
        edge2: tuple[float, float, float],
        edge3: tuple[float, float, float],
        times: pinnjax.Time | float | None = None,
        *,
        initial: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        # Create interior box
        interior = Box(
            origin=origin,
            edge1=edge1,
            edge2=edge2,
            edge3=edge3,
            times=times,
        )

        # Create 6 boundary faces
        o = jnp.array(origin)
        e1 = jnp.array(edge1)
        e2 = jnp.array(edge2)
        e3 = jnp.array(edge3)

        # LEFT (-X)
        left_face = Rectangle(origin=o, edge1=e3, edge2=e2, times=times)
        # RIGHT (+X)
        right_face = Rectangle(origin=o + e1, edge1=e2, edge2=e3, times=times)

        # FRONT (-Y)
        front_face = Rectangle(origin=o, edge1=e1, edge2=e3, times=times)
        # BACK (+Y)
        back_face = Rectangle(origin=o + e2, edge1=e3, edge2=e1, times=times)

        # BOTTOM (-Z)
        bottom_face = Rectangle(origin=o, edge1=e2, edge2=e1, times=times)
        # TOP (+Z)
        top_face = Rectangle(origin=o + e3, edge1=e1, edge2=e2, times=times)

        shapes = [
            interior,
            left_face,
            right_face,
            front_face,
            back_face,
            bottom_face,
            top_face,
        ]
        super().__init__(shapes)

        self.initials_set = False
        if initial:
            self.add_initial()

        self.path_set = False

        # Store references for easy access
        self.interior = interior
        self.left_face = left_face
        self.right_face = right_face
        self.back_face = back_face
        self.front_face = front_face
        self.bottom_face = bottom_face
        self.top_face = top_face

        # Store the original parameters
        self.origin = o
        self.edge1 = e1
        self.edge2 = e2
        self.edge3 = e3
        self.times = times

        # ensure all faces and normals face outwards.
        faces_and_normals = [
            (
                self.left_face,
                jnp.cross(
                    jnp.array(self.left_face.edge1),
                    jnp.array(self.left_face.edge2),
                ),
            ),
            (
                self.right_face,
                jnp.cross(
                    jnp.array(self.right_face.edge1),
                    jnp.array(self.right_face.edge2),
                ),
            ),
            (
                self.front_face,
                jnp.cross(
                    jnp.array(self.front_face.edge1),
                    jnp.array(self.front_face.edge2),
                ),
            ),
            (
                self.back_face,
                jnp.cross(
                    jnp.array(self.back_face.edge1),
                    jnp.array(self.back_face.edge2),
                ),
            ),
            (
                self.bottom_face,
                jnp.cross(
                    jnp.array(self.bottom_face.edge1),
                    jnp.array(self.bottom_face.edge2),
                ),
            ),
            (
                self.top_face,
                jnp.cross(
                    jnp.array(self.top_face.edge1),
                    jnp.array(self.top_face.edge2),
                ),
            ),
        ]

        # Normalize
        faces_and_normals = [
            (face, n / (jnp.linalg.norm(n) + 1e-12)) for face, n in faces_and_normals
        ]

        for face, n in faces_and_normals:
            face._outward_normal = n
            face.normal = lambda nn=n: nn

    def add_initial(self) -> None:
        if not self.initials_set:
            self.shapes.append(
                Box(
                    origin=self.origin,
                    edge1=self.edge1,
                    edge2=self.edge2,
                    edge3=self.edge3,
                    times=self.times.min,
                ),
            )
            self.initials_set = True
            return
        config.LOGGER.warning(
            "Initial Domain has already been added to this ComplexShape.",
        )
        return

    def add_path_shape(
        self,
        path: pinnjax.Path,
        radius: float | Iterable = 1.0,
    ) -> None:
        if isinstance(radius, (int, float)):
            radius = len(self.origin) * (radius,)

        if any(r <= 0.0 for r in radius):
            msg = f"{radius} is invalid. Must be greater than zero."
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        if len(radius) != len(self.origin):
            msg = (
                f"radius: {radius} must have the same number of "
                f"dims as spatial-domain: {len(self.origin)} "
            )
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        if not self.path_set:
            match type(path):
                case pinnjax.LinearPath:
                    end_point = path.initial + path.velocity * self.times.max
                    initial = tuple(
                        float(max(x - r, o))
                        for x, o, r in zip(
                            path.initial,
                            self.origin,
                            tuple(radius),
                            strict=True,
                        )
                    )
                    end = tuple(
                        float(min(x + r, o))
                        for x, o, r in zip(
                            end_point,
                            self.origin + self._get_domain_dimensions(),
                            tuple(radius),
                            strict=True,
                        )
                    )
                    path_domain = pinnjax.SpatialDomain(
                        min=initial,
                        max=end,
                        times=self.times,
                    )
                    obb = path_domain.to_obb()
                    self.shapes.append(Box(*obb, times=self.times))
                    # this adds a shape on the boundary at the +z
                    # generalization in the future might be smart
                    origin, edge1, edge2, edge3 = obb
                    o = jnp.array(origin)
                    e1 = jnp.array(edge1)
                    e2 = jnp.array(edge2)
                    e3 = jnp.array(edge3)
                    self.shapes.append(
                        Rectangle(origin=o + e3, edge1=e1, edge2=e2, times=self.times),
                    )
                    self.path = path
                    self.path_set = True
                case pinnjax.ComplexLinearPath:
                    internal_shapes = []
                    boundary_shapes = []
                    for i, segment in enumerate(path.segments):
                        end_point = (
                            segment.initial + segment.velocity * path.segment_times[i]
                        )
                        initial = tuple(
                            float(max(x - r, o))
                            for x, o, r in zip(
                                segment.initial,
                                self.origin,
                                tuple(radius),
                                strict=True,
                            )
                        )
                        end = tuple(
                            float(min(x + r, o))
                            for x, o, r in zip(
                                end_point,
                                self.origin + self._get_domain_dimensions(),
                                tuple(radius),
                                strict=True,
                            )
                        )
                        path_domain = pinnjax.SpatialDomain(min=initial, max=end)

                        time = pinnjax.Time(
                            min=path.cumulative_times[i],
                            max=path.cumulative_times[i + 1],
                            step=self.times.step,
                        )
                        obb = path_domain.to_obb()
                        internal_shapes.append(pinnjax.Box(*obb, times=time))

                        origin, edge1, edge2, edge3 = obb
                        o = jnp.array(origin)
                        e1 = jnp.array(edge1)
                        e2 = jnp.array(edge2)
                        e3 = jnp.array(edge3)
                        boundary_shapes.append(
                            Rectangle(origin=o + e3, edge1=e1, edge2=e2, times=time),
                        )

                    self.shapes.append(
                        pinnjax.ComplexShape(internal_shapes, times=self.times),
                    )
                    self.shapes.append(
                        pinnjax.ComplexShape(boundary_shapes, times=self.times),
                    )

                    self.path = path
                    self.path_set = True
                case _:
                    # TODO(@mjryande): Add the CirclePath
                    config.LOGGER.warning(
                        "Additional Points have not yet been "
                        "implemented for the %s path type.",
                        type(path).__name__,
                    )
                    config.LOGGER.warning("Try using a Linear or ComplexLinear path.")
                    config.LOGGER.warning(
                        "Evaluation will continue as normal, "
                        "but no additional points have been added.",
                    )
            return
        config.LOGGER.warning(
            "Additional Points have already been added to this ComplexShape",
        )
        return

    def show_samples(
        self,
        *,
        color: str = "dodgerblue",
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (10, 8),
        show: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        if fig is None or ax is None:
            fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
            ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

        ax.set_rasterization_zorder(0)
        for shape in self.shapes:
            if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
                for s in shape.shapes:
                    _samples = s.samples
                    ax.plot(
                        _samples[:, 0],
                        _samples[:, 1],
                        _samples[:, 2],
                        color=color,
                        linestyle="None",
                        marker=".",
                        markersize=1,
                        zorder=-1,
                    )
            else:
                _samples = shape.samples
                ax.plot(
                    _samples[:, 0],
                    _samples[:, 1],
                    _samples[:, 2],
                    color=color,
                    linestyle="None",
                    marker=".",
                    markersize=1,
                    zorder=-1,
                )

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

    def draw(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        show_samples: bool = False,
        show_path: bool = False,
        colored_walls: bool = False,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (12, 10),
        show: bool = True,
        save: bool | None = False,
        save_location: str | Path | None = None,
        save_name: str | None = "geometry.pdf",
        save_format: str = "pdf",
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes]:
        if fig is None or ax is None:
            fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
            ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

        dimensions = self._get_domain_dimensions()

        # Draw faces
        faces = [
            self.left_face,
            self.right_face,
            self.back_face,
            self.front_face,
            self.bottom_face,
            self.top_face,
        ]
        face_names = [
            "Left BC",
            "Right BC",
            "Back BC",
            "Front BC",
            "Bottom BC",
            "Top BC",
        ]
        face_colors = ["blue", "red", "green", "orange", "purple", "brown"]

        for face, name, color in zip(faces, face_names, face_colors, strict=True):
            if colored_walls:
                _draw_filled_face_3d(ax, face, color=color, alpha=0.3, label=name)

            if show_normals:
                self._draw_face_normal(ax, face, color=color)

        for shape in self.shapes:
            if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
                for s in shape.shapes:
                    s.draw(fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)
            else:
                shape.draw(fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)

        if show_samples:
            fig, ax = self.show_samples(fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)

        if show_path and self.path_set:
            self.path.draw(domain=None, time=self.times, fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)

        # Set aspect ratio to match actual domain proportions
        max_dim = max(dimensions)
        aspect_ratios = [max(0.2, d / max_dim) for d in dimensions]

        ax.set_box_aspect(aspect_ratios)

        ax.set_xlabel("X")
        ax.set_ylabel("Y")
        ax.set_zlabel("Z")
        if colored_walls:
            ax.legend(loc="upper right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.15, 1))

        fig.tight_layout()

        if save:
            out_dir = Path(save_location) if save_location else Path.cwd()
            out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            out_path = out_dir / (save_name or "geometry.pdf")
            ext = out_path.suffix.lower()
            fmt = (
                ext.lstrip(".")
                if ext
                else (
                    save_format.lstrip(".") if isinstance(save_format, str) else "pdf"
                )
            )
            fig.savefig(out_path, bbox_inches="tight", format=fmt or "pdf", dpi=300)

        if show:
            plt.show()

        return fig, ax

    def _collect_samples_with_time(self) -> Array | None:
        """Collect all samples from shapes into (N, 4) array [x, y, z, t].


        Returns None if no samples.

        """
        parts = []
        for shape in self.shapes:
            if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
                for s in shape.shapes:
                    if s.samples is not None:
                        parts.append(jnp.array(s.samples))
            else:
                if shape.samples is not None:
                    parts.append(jnp.array(shape.samples))
        if not parts:
            return None
        return jnp.vstack(parts)

    def animate(
        self,
        *,
        show_normals: bool = False,
        show_samples: bool = True,
        additive: bool = False,
        show_path: bool = True,
        colored_walls: bool = False,
        fig: Figure | None = None,
        ax: Axes | None = None,
        fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (12, 10),
        show: bool = True,
        save: bool | None = True,
        save_location: str | Path | None = None,
        save_name: str | None = "geometry.gif",
        n_frames: int | None = None,
        interval: int | None = 80,
        fps: int | None = 15,
        dpi: int = 300,
    ) -> tuple[Figure, Axes, FuncAnimation]:
        """Animate geometry over time.


        Keyword Args:
            show_normals: Draw face normals.
            show_samples: Show collocation samples (filtered by time each frame).
            additive: If True, samples accumulate over time; if False, only
                samples in the current frame's time interval are shown.
            show_path: Show path from start to current time each frame.
            colored_walls: Use colored faces.

            fig: Optional Matplotlib Figure.
            ax: Optional Matplotlib Axes.
            fig_size: Figure size.
            show: Whether to display with plt.show().
            save: Whether to save the gif (default True).
            save_location: Directory for saved gif.
            save_name: Output filename (default ``geometry.gif``).
            n_frames: Number of frames (default from time steps).
            interval: Milliseconds between frames (display).
            fps: Frames per second for saved gif.


        Returns:
            fig, ax, anim: Matplotlib figure, axes, and animation object.
        """
        if fig is None or ax is None:
            fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
            ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

        dimensions = self._get_domain_dimensions()
        faces = [
            self.left_face,
            self.right_face,
            self.back_face,
            self.front_face,
            self.bottom_face,
            self.top_face,
        ]
        face_names = [
            "Left BC",
            "Right BC",
            "Back BC",
            "Front BC",
            "Bottom BC",
            "Top BC",
        ]
        face_colors = ["blue", "red", "green", "orange", "purple", "brown"]

        # Draw static box (faces and shape outlines) once
        for face, name, color in zip(faces, face_names, face_colors, strict=True):
            if colored_walls:
                _draw_filled_face_3d(ax, face, color=color, alpha=0.3, label=name)
            if show_normals:
                self._draw_face_normal(ax, face, color=color)
        for shape in self.shapes:
            if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
                for s in shape.shapes:
                    s.draw(fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)
            else:
                shape.draw(fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)

        max_dim = max(dimensions)
        aspect_ratios = [max(0.2, d / max_dim) for d in dimensions]
        ax.set_box_aspect(aspect_ratios)
        ax.set_xlabel("X")
        ax.set_ylabel("Y")
        ax.set_zlabel("Z")
        if colored_walls:
            ax.legend(loc="upper right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.15, 1))
        fig.tight_layout()

        all_samples = self._collect_samples_with_time()
        time_min = float(self.times.min)
        time_max = float(self.times.max)
        time_steps = int((time_max - time_min) / self.times.step)
        if n_frames is None:
            n_frames = min(80, max(10, time_steps))
        frame_times = jnp.linspace(time_min, time_max, n_frames)

        # Path segment lines (active=solid, inactive=dashed); redraw each frame
        path_line_artists = []
        # Samples scatter (only current frame's time interval)
        samples_scatter = ax.scatter(
            [],
            [],
            [],
            color="dodgerblue",
            linestyle="None",
            marker=".",
            s=1,
            zorder=-1,
        )

        def _path_segments_by_active(path, coords, path_times):
            """Return list of (start_idx, end_idx, is_active) for path segments."""
            n = coords.shape[0]
            if n == 0:
                return []
            active = []
            for i in range(n):
                u = jnp.concatenate([coords[i], jnp.array([float(path_times[i])])])
                a = path.get_active(u)
                active.append(bool(float(a)))
            segments = []
            i = 0
            while i < n:
                j = i
                while j < n and active[j] == active[i]:
                    j += 1
                segments.append((i, j, active[i]))
                i = j
            return segments

        def update(frame_idx: int):
            t_max = float(frame_times[frame_idx])

            for art in path_line_artists:
                art.remove()
            path_line_artists.clear()

            if show_path and self.path_set:
                path_times = jnp.linspace(time_min, t_max, max(20, frame_idx + 2))
                coords = self.path.eval(path_times)
                if coords.shape[0] >= 2:
                    for start, end, is_active in _path_segments_by_active(
                        self.path,
                        coords,
                        path_times,
                    ):
                        if end - start < 2:
                            continue
                        seg = coords[start:end]
                        style = "-" if is_active else "--"
                        width = 3 if is_active else 1
                        (line,) = ax.plot3D(
                            np.asarray(seg[:, 0]),
                            np.asarray(seg[:, 1]),
                            np.asarray(seg[:, 2]),
                            color="red",
                            linewidth=width,
                            linestyle=style,
                            zorder=5,
                        )
                        path_line_artists.append(line)

            if show_samples and all_samples is not None:
                t = np.asarray(all_samples[:, -1])
                t_hi = float(frame_times[frame_idx])
                if additive:
                    mask = t <= t_hi
                else:
                    t_lo = (
                        time_min - 1e-10
                        if frame_idx == 0
                        else float(frame_times[frame_idx - 1])
                    )
                    mask = (t > t_lo) & (t <= t_hi)
                pts = np.asarray(all_samples[mask, :3])
                if pts.size > 0:
                    samples_scatter.set_offsets(pts[:, :2])
                    samples_scatter.set_3d_properties(pts[:, 2], zdir="z")
                else:
                    samples_scatter.set_offsets(np.empty((0, 2)))
                    samples_scatter.set_3d_properties(np.array([]), zdir="z")
            else:
                samples_scatter.set_offsets(np.empty((0, 2)))
                samples_scatter.set_3d_properties(np.array([]), zdir="z")

            return (samples_scatter,)

        anim = FuncAnimation(
            fig,
            update,
            frames=n_frames,
            interval=interval,
            blit=False,
            repeat=True,
        )

        if save:
            out_dir = Path(save_location) if save_location else Path.cwd()
            out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            out_path = out_dir / (save_name or "geometry.gif")
            writer = PillowWriter(fps=fps, bitrate=-1)
            anim.save(out_path, writer=writer, dpi=dpi)

        if show:
            plt.show()
        else:
            plt.close()

        return fig, ax, anim

    def _draw_face_normal(
        self,
        ax: Axes,
        face: pinnjax.Rectangle,
        color: str = "blue",
        scale: float = 0.5,
    ) -> None:
        """Draw face normal arrows."""
        # Get face center
        o = jnp.array(face.origin)
        e1, e2 = jnp.array(face.edge1), jnp.array(face.edge2)
        center = o + 0.5 * (e1 + e2)

        try:
            normal = face.normal()
            dimensions = self._get_domain_dimensions()

            scaled_arrow = normal * dimensions * scale

            ax.quiver(
                center[0],
                center[1],
                center[2],
                scaled_arrow[0],
                scaled_arrow[1],
                scaled_arrow[2],
                color=color,
                alpha=0.9,
                arrow_length_ratio=0.15,
                linewidth=2,
            )

        except (ValueError, ArithmeticError, IndexError) as e:
            config.LOGGER.warning(
                "Could not draw normal due to mathematical error: %s",
                e,
            )

    def _get_domain_dimensions(self) -> Array:
        """Calculate the actual dimensions of the domain."""
        min_corner = self.origin
        max_corner = self.origin + self.edge1 + self.edge2 + self.edge3
        return abs(max_corner - min_corner)

def __init__(
    self,
    origin: tuple[float, float, float],
    edge1: tuple[float, float, float],
    edge2: tuple[float, float, float],
    edge3: tuple[float, float, float],
    times: pinnjax.Time | float | None = None,
    *,
    initial: bool = False,
) -> None:
    # Create interior box
    interior = Box(
        origin=origin,
        edge1=edge1,
        edge2=edge2,
        edge3=edge3,
        times=times,
    )

    # Create 6 boundary faces
    o = jnp.array(origin)
    e1 = jnp.array(edge1)
    e2 = jnp.array(edge2)
    e3 = jnp.array(edge3)

    # LEFT (-X)
    left_face = Rectangle(origin=o, edge1=e3, edge2=e2, times=times)
    # RIGHT (+X)
    right_face = Rectangle(origin=o + e1, edge1=e2, edge2=e3, times=times)

    # FRONT (-Y)
    front_face = Rectangle(origin=o, edge1=e1, edge2=e3, times=times)
    # BACK (+Y)
    back_face = Rectangle(origin=o + e2, edge1=e3, edge2=e1, times=times)

    # BOTTOM (-Z)
    bottom_face = Rectangle(origin=o, edge1=e2, edge2=e1, times=times)
    # TOP (+Z)
    top_face = Rectangle(origin=o + e3, edge1=e1, edge2=e2, times=times)

    shapes = [
        interior,
        left_face,
        right_face,
        front_face,
        back_face,
        bottom_face,
        top_face,
    ]
    super().__init__(shapes)

    self.initials_set = False
    if initial:
        self.add_initial()

    self.path_set = False

    # Store references for easy access
    self.interior = interior
    self.left_face = left_face
    self.right_face = right_face
    self.back_face = back_face
    self.front_face = front_face
    self.bottom_face = bottom_face
    self.top_face = top_face

    # Store the original parameters
    self.origin = o
    self.edge1 = e1
    self.edge2 = e2
    self.edge3 = e3
    self.times = times

    # ensure all faces and normals face outwards.
    faces_and_normals = [
        (
            self.left_face,
            jnp.cross(
                jnp.array(self.left_face.edge1),
                jnp.array(self.left_face.edge2),
            ),
        ),
        (
            self.right_face,
            jnp.cross(
                jnp.array(self.right_face.edge1),
                jnp.array(self.right_face.edge2),
            ),
        ),
        (
            self.front_face,
            jnp.cross(
                jnp.array(self.front_face.edge1),
                jnp.array(self.front_face.edge2),
            ),
        ),
        (
            self.back_face,
            jnp.cross(
                jnp.array(self.back_face.edge1),
                jnp.array(self.back_face.edge2),
            ),
        ),
        (
            self.bottom_face,
            jnp.cross(
                jnp.array(self.bottom_face.edge1),
                jnp.array(self.bottom_face.edge2),
            ),
        ),
        (
            self.top_face,
            jnp.cross(
                jnp.array(self.top_face.edge1),
                jnp.array(self.top_face.edge2),
            ),
        ),
    ]

    # Normalize
    faces_and_normals = [
        (face, n / (jnp.linalg.norm(n) + 1e-12)) for face, n in faces_and_normals
    ]

    for face, n in faces_and_normals:
        face._outward_normal = n
        face.normal = lambda nn=n: nn

def add_initial(self) -> None:
    if not self.initials_set:
        self.shapes.append(
            Box(
                origin=self.origin,
                edge1=self.edge1,
                edge2=self.edge2,
                edge3=self.edge3,
                times=self.times.min,
            ),
        )
        self.initials_set = True
        return
    config.LOGGER.warning(
        "Initial Domain has already been added to this ComplexShape.",
    )
    return

def add_path_shape(
    self,
    path: pinnjax.Path,
    radius: float | Iterable = 1.0,
) -> None:
    if isinstance(radius, (int, float)):
        radius = len(self.origin) * (radius,)

    if any(r <= 0.0 for r in radius):
        msg = f"{radius} is invalid. Must be greater than zero."
        config.LOGGER.error(msg)
        raise ValueError(msg)

    if len(radius) != len(self.origin):
        msg = (
            f"radius: {radius} must have the same number of "
            f"dims as spatial-domain: {len(self.origin)} "
        )
        config.LOGGER.error(msg)
        raise ValueError(msg)

    if not self.path_set:
        match type(path):
            case pinnjax.LinearPath:
                end_point = path.initial + path.velocity * self.times.max
                initial = tuple(
                    float(max(x - r, o))
                    for x, o, r in zip(
                        path.initial,
                        self.origin,
                        tuple(radius),
                        strict=True,
                    )
                )
                end = tuple(
                    float(min(x + r, o))
                    for x, o, r in zip(
                        end_point,
                        self.origin + self._get_domain_dimensions(),
                        tuple(radius),
                        strict=True,
                    )
                )
                path_domain = pinnjax.SpatialDomain(
                    min=initial,
                    max=end,
                    times=self.times,
                )
                obb = path_domain.to_obb()
                self.shapes.append(Box(*obb, times=self.times))
                # this adds a shape on the boundary at the +z
                # generalization in the future might be smart
                origin, edge1, edge2, edge3 = obb
                o = jnp.array(origin)
                e1 = jnp.array(edge1)
                e2 = jnp.array(edge2)
                e3 = jnp.array(edge3)
                self.shapes.append(
                    Rectangle(origin=o + e3, edge1=e1, edge2=e2, times=self.times),
                )
                self.path = path
                self.path_set = True
            case pinnjax.ComplexLinearPath:
                internal_shapes = []
                boundary_shapes = []
                for i, segment in enumerate(path.segments):
                    end_point = (
                        segment.initial + segment.velocity * path.segment_times[i]
                    )
                    initial = tuple(
                        float(max(x - r, o))
                        for x, o, r in zip(
                            segment.initial,
                            self.origin,
                            tuple(radius),
                            strict=True,
                        )
                    )
                    end = tuple(
                        float(min(x + r, o))
                        for x, o, r in zip(
                            end_point,
                            self.origin + self._get_domain_dimensions(),
                            tuple(radius),
                            strict=True,
                        )
                    )
                    path_domain = pinnjax.SpatialDomain(min=initial, max=end)

                    time = pinnjax.Time(
                        min=path.cumulative_times[i],
                        max=path.cumulative_times[i + 1],
                        step=self.times.step,
                    )
                    obb = path_domain.to_obb()
                    internal_shapes.append(pinnjax.Box(*obb, times=time))

                    origin, edge1, edge2, edge3 = obb
                    o = jnp.array(origin)
                    e1 = jnp.array(edge1)
                    e2 = jnp.array(edge2)
                    e3 = jnp.array(edge3)
                    boundary_shapes.append(
                        Rectangle(origin=o + e3, edge1=e1, edge2=e2, times=time),
                    )

                self.shapes.append(
                    pinnjax.ComplexShape(internal_shapes, times=self.times),
                )
                self.shapes.append(
                    pinnjax.ComplexShape(boundary_shapes, times=self.times),
                )

                self.path = path
                self.path_set = True
            case _:
                # TODO(@mjryande): Add the CirclePath
                config.LOGGER.warning(
                    "Additional Points have not yet been "
                    "implemented for the %s path type.",
                    type(path).__name__,
                )
                config.LOGGER.warning("Try using a Linear or ComplexLinear path.")
                config.LOGGER.warning(
                    "Evaluation will continue as normal, "
                    "but no additional points have been added.",
                )
        return
    config.LOGGER.warning(
        "Additional Points have already been added to this ComplexShape",
    )
    return

def animate(
    self,
    *,
    show_normals: bool = False,
    show_samples: bool = True,
    additive: bool = False,
    show_path: bool = True,
    colored_walls: bool = False,
    fig: Figure | None = None,
    ax: Axes | None = None,
    fig_size: tuple[int, int] | None = (12, 10),
    show: bool = True,
    save: bool | None = True,
    save_location: str | Path | None = None,
    save_name: str | None = "geometry.gif",
    n_frames: int | None = None,
    interval: int | None = 80,
    fps: int | None = 15,
    dpi: int = 300,
) -> tuple[Figure, Axes, FuncAnimation]:
    """Animate geometry over time.


    Keyword Args:
        show_normals: Draw face normals.
        show_samples: Show collocation samples (filtered by time each frame).
        additive: If True, samples accumulate over time; if False, only
            samples in the current frame's time interval are shown.
        show_path: Show path from start to current time each frame.
        colored_walls: Use colored faces.

        fig: Optional Matplotlib Figure.
        ax: Optional Matplotlib Axes.
        fig_size: Figure size.
        show: Whether to display with plt.show().
        save: Whether to save the gif (default True).
        save_location: Directory for saved gif.
        save_name: Output filename (default ``geometry.gif``).
        n_frames: Number of frames (default from time steps).
        interval: Milliseconds between frames (display).
        fps: Frames per second for saved gif.


    Returns:
        fig, ax, anim: Matplotlib figure, axes, and animation object.
    """
    if fig is None or ax is None:
        fig = plt.figure(figsize=fig_size)
        ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="3d")

    dimensions = self._get_domain_dimensions()
    faces = [
        self.left_face,
        self.right_face,
        self.back_face,
        self.front_face,
        self.bottom_face,
        self.top_face,
    ]
    face_names = [
        "Left BC",
        "Right BC",
        "Back BC",
        "Front BC",
        "Bottom BC",
        "Top BC",
    ]
    face_colors = ["blue", "red", "green", "orange", "purple", "brown"]

    # Draw static box (faces and shape outlines) once
    for face, name, color in zip(faces, face_names, face_colors, strict=True):
        if colored_walls:
            _draw_filled_face_3d(ax, face, color=color, alpha=0.3, label=name)
        if show_normals:
            self._draw_face_normal(ax, face, color=color)
    for shape in self.shapes:
        if isinstance(shape, ComplexShape):
            for s in shape.shapes:
                s.draw(fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)
        else:
            shape.draw(fig=fig, ax=ax, show=False)

    max_dim = max(dimensions)
    aspect_ratios = [max(0.2, d / max_dim) for d in dimensions]
    ax.set_box_aspect(aspect_ratios)
    ax.set_xlabel("X")
    ax.set_ylabel("Y")
    ax.set_zlabel("Z")
    if colored_walls:
        ax.legend(loc="upper right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.15, 1))
    fig.tight_layout()

    all_samples = self._collect_samples_with_time()
    time_min = float(self.times.min)
    time_max = float(self.times.max)
    time_steps = int((time_max - time_min) / self.times.step)
    if n_frames is None:
        n_frames = min(80, max(10, time_steps))
    frame_times = jnp.linspace(time_min, time_max, n_frames)

    # Path segment lines (active=solid, inactive=dashed); redraw each frame
    path_line_artists = []
    # Samples scatter (only current frame's time interval)
    samples_scatter = ax.scatter(
        [],
        [],
        [],
        color="dodgerblue",
        linestyle="None",
        marker=".",
        s=1,
        zorder=-1,
    )

    def _path_segments_by_active(path, coords, path_times):
        """Return list of (start_idx, end_idx, is_active) for path segments."""
        n = coords.shape[0]
        if n == 0:
            return []
        active = []
        for i in range(n):
            u = jnp.concatenate([coords[i], jnp.array([float(path_times[i])])])
            a = path.get_active(u)
            active.append(bool(float(a)))
        segments = []
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            j = i
            while j < n and active[j] == active[i]:
                j += 1
            segments.append((i, j, active[i]))
            i = j
        return segments

    def update(frame_idx: int):
        t_max = float(frame_times[frame_idx])

        for art in path_line_artists:
            art.remove()
        path_line_artists.clear()

        if show_path and self.path_set:
            path_times = jnp.linspace(time_min, t_max, max(20, frame_idx + 2))
            coords = self.path.eval(path_times)
            if coords.shape[0] >= 2:
                for start, end, is_active in _path_segments_by_active(
                    self.path,
                    coords,
                    path_times,
                ):
                    if end - start < 2:
                        continue
                    seg = coords[start:end]
                    style = "-" if is_active else "--"
                    width = 3 if is_active else 1
                    (line,) = ax.plot3D(
                        np.asarray(seg[:, 0]),
                        np.asarray(seg[:, 1]),
                        np.asarray(seg[:, 2]),
                        color="red",
                        linewidth=width,
                        linestyle=style,
                        zorder=5,
                    )
                    path_line_artists.append(line)

        if show_samples and all_samples is not None:
            t = np.asarray(all_samples[:, -1])
            t_hi = float(frame_times[frame_idx])
            if additive:
                mask = t <= t_hi
            else:
                t_lo = (
                    time_min - 1e-10
                    if frame_idx == 0
                    else float(frame_times[frame_idx - 1])
                )
                mask = (t > t_lo) & (t <= t_hi)
            pts = np.asarray(all_samples[mask, :3])
            if pts.size > 0:
                samples_scatter.set_offsets(pts[:, :2])
                samples_scatter.set_3d_properties(pts[:, 2], zdir="z")
            else:
                samples_scatter.set_offsets(np.empty((0, 2)))
                samples_scatter.set_3d_properties(np.array([]), zdir="z")
        else:
            samples_scatter.set_offsets(np.empty((0, 2)))
            samples_scatter.set_3d_properties(np.array([]), zdir="z")

        return (samples_scatter,)

    anim = FuncAnimation(
        fig,
        update,
        frames=n_frames,
        interval=interval,
        blit=False,
        repeat=True,
    )

    if save:
        out_dir = Path(save_location) if save_location else Path.cwd()
        out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out_path = out_dir / (save_name or "geometry.gif")
        writer = PillowWriter(fps=fps, bitrate=-1)
        anim.save(out_path, writer=writer, dpi=dpi)

    if show:
        plt.show()
    else:
        plt.close()

    return fig, ax, anim

class OperatorGeometry(ComplexShape):
    def __init__(
        self,
        spatial_geometry: ComplexShape,
        descriptor_shape: Hypercube,
        *,
        operator_domain: pinnjax.OperatorDomain | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if not isinstance(spatial_geometry, ComplexShape):
            raise TypeError(
                "spatial_geometry must be a ComplexShape "
                "(e.g. BoundedLine, BoundedRectangle, BoundedBox)."
            )
        if not isinstance(descriptor_shape, Hypercube):
            raise TypeError("descriptor_shape must be a Hypercube.")

        self.spatial_geometry = spatial_geometry
        self.descriptor_shape = descriptor_shape

        # Share child shapes with inner geometry
        super().__init__(spatial_geometry.shapes, times=spatial_geometry.times)

        self.query_dim = self._infer_query_dim(spatial_geometry)
        self.operator_dim = None

        if operator_domain is not None:
            self.operator_domain = operator_domain
            expected_query_dim = self._query_dim_from_domain(operator_domain.query)
            if expected_query_dim != self.query_dim:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"operator_domain query dim ({expected_query_dim}) "
                    f"!= spatial query_dim ({self.query_dim})"
                )
            if operator_domain.descriptor != descriptor_shape.domain:
                raise ValueError(
                    "operator_domain.descriptor does not match descriptor_shape.domain."
                )
        else:
            self.operator_domain = None

    @staticmethod
    def _infer_query_dim(spatial_geometry: pinnjax.ComplexShape) -> int:
        for shape in spatial_geometry.shapes:
            d = getattr(shape, "dims", 0)
            if d > 0:
                return int(d)
        raise ValueError("Could not infer query_dim from spatial_geometry.")

    @staticmethod
    def _query_dim_from_domain(domain: pinnjax.SpatialDomain) -> int:
        n = len(domain.min)
        if domain.times is not None:
            n += 1
        return n

    @staticmethod
    def _descriptor_rows(descriptor_shape: Hypercube) -> Array:
        if descriptor_shape.evaluated_values is not None:
            rows = jnp.asarray(
                descriptor_shape.evaluated_values,
                dtype=config.get_dtype(),
            )
        elif descriptor_shape.samples is not None:
            rows = jnp.asarray(
                descriptor_shape.samples,
                dtype=config.get_dtype(),
            )
        else:
            raise ValueError("descriptor_shape must be sampled before pairing.")

        if rows.ndim == 1:
            rows = rows[None, :]
        elif rows.ndim > 2:
            rows = rows.reshape(rows.shape[0], -1)

        return rows

    @staticmethod
    def _pair(query_samples: Array, descriptor_samples: Array) -> Array:
        n_q = query_samples.shape[0]
        n_d = descriptor_samples.shape[0]

        query_expanded = jnp.repeat(query_samples, n_d, axis=0)
        descriptor_expanded = jnp.tile(descriptor_samples, (n_q, 1))

        return jnp.concatenate([query_expanded, descriptor_expanded], axis=-1)

    def samples(
        self,
        method: pinnjax.SamplingMethod,
        sampling_values: float | list[float] | None = None,
        *,
        descriptor_count: int = 32,
        overwrite: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        self.spatial_geometry.samples(method, sampling_values, overwrite=overwrite)
        self.descriptor_shape.sample(method, descriptor_count)

        descriptor_samples = self._descriptor_rows(self.descriptor_shape)
        self.operator_dim = int(descriptor_samples.shape[-1])

        self.n_points = 0
        for shape in self.shapes:
            if shape.samples is None:
                continue

            if shape.samples.shape[-1] != self.query_dim:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Expected query width {self.query_dim}, "
                    f"got {shape.samples.shape[-1]}"
                )

            shape.samples = self._pair(shape.samples, descriptor_samples)
            shape.n_points = int(shape.samples.shape[0])
            self.n_points += shape.n_points

    def draw(self, **kwargs):
        return self.spatial_geometry.draw(**kwargs)

class DataGeometry(ComplexShape, ABC):
    def __init__(
        self,
        inputs: Array,
        outputs: Array,
        *,
        indices: Array | Sequence[int] | None = None,
        portion: float = 1.0,
        materialize_validation_from_portion: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        data_shape = DataShape(
            inputs,
            outputs,
            indices=indices,
            portion=portion,
            materialize_validation_from_portion=materialize_validation_from_portion,
        )
        super().__init__([data_shape])
        self.data_shape = data_shape

    @classmethod
    def _from_data_shape(cls, data_shape: DataShape) -> DataGeometry:
        self = object.__new__(cls)
        ComplexShape.__init__(self, [data_shape])
        self.data_shape = data_shape
        return self

    def duplicate_data_shape(
        self,
        times: int = 1,
        *,
        copy_split: bool = True,
    ) -> list[pinnjax.DataShape]:
        if times < 1:
            raise ValueError(f"`times` must be >= 1, got {times}.")
        duplicates: list[pinnjax.DataShape] = []
        for _ in range(times):
            ds = self.data_shape.clone(copy_split=copy_split)
            self.shapes.append(ds)
            duplicates.append(ds)
        return duplicates

    @classmethod
    def from_files(
        cls,
        path: Path | str,
        *,
        input_folder_name: str = "input",
        output_folder_name: str = "output",
        portion: float = 1.0,
        mat_key: str = "groundTruth",
        resort: bool = False,
    ) -> DataGeometry:
        ds = DataShape.from_files(
            path,
            portion=portion,
            input_folder_name=input_folder_name,
            output_folder_name=output_folder_name,
            mat_key=mat_key,
            resort=resort,
        )
        return cls._from_data_shape(ds)

    @classmethod
    def from_table(
        cls,
        table: str | Path | pl.DataFrame,
        *,
        input_columns: str | int | Sequence[str] | Sequence[int],
        output_columns: str | int | Sequence[str] | Sequence[int],
        portion: float = 1.0,
        drop_nulls: bool = True,
        materialize_validation_from_portion: bool = True,
    ) -> DataGeometry:
        ds = DataShape.from_table(
            table,
            input_columns=input_columns,
            output_columns=output_columns,
            portion=portion,
            drop_nulls=drop_nulls,
            materialize_validation_from_portion=materialize_validation_from_portion,
        )
        return cls._from_data_shape(ds)

    def validate(
        self,
        model: pinnjax.NeuralNetwork,
        evaluation: pinnjax.Evaluation | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, float]:
        """Metrics on rows held out by ``portion`` (not in the main tabular pool).

        If validation was deferred at construction, materializes it when deferred
        indices exist. If nothing was held out at construction (e.g. ``portion=1.0``),
        logs a warning and returns ``{}`` — calling
        [`materialize_validation_from_portion`][pinnjax.DataShape.materialize_validation_from_portion]
        cannot create rows after the fact.

        With ``evaluation=None``, builds a
        [`TabularPointwiseEvaluation`][pinnjax.TabularPointwiseEvaluation] and binds validation
        rows. If you pass an ``evaluation`` (e.g. the same
        [`TabularPointwiseEvaluation`][pinnjax.TabularPointwiseEvaluation] or another tabular
        subclass used during training), it is **shallow-copied**, ``.inputs`` and ``.truth`` are
        set to the validation arrays, then ``evaluate(model)`` is called so the original instance
        is unchanged.
        """
        from pinnjax.loss import TabularPointwiseEvaluation

        ds = self.data_shape
        if ds.validation_inputs is None and (
            ds._validation_indices is not None and ds._validation_indices.size > 0
        ):
            ds.materialize_validation_from_portion()
        if ds.validation_inputs is None or ds.validation_inputs.shape[0] == 0:
            config.LOGGER.warning(
                "All DATA was used in training/testing. Use a portion less than 1.0. "
                "Returning empty metrics.",
            )
            return {}
        if evaluation is None:
            evaluation = TabularPointwiseEvaluation()
            evaluation.bind_tabular_data(ds.validation_inputs, ds.validation_outputs)
        else:
            ev = copy.copy(evaluation)
            if not hasattr(ev, "inputs") or not hasattr(ev, "truth"):
                msg = (
                    "When passing evaluation, it must have .inputs and .truth so "

def duplicate_data_shape(
    self,
    times: int = 1,
    *,
    copy_split: bool = True,
) -> list[pinnjax.DataShape]:
    if times < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"`times` must be >= 1, got {times}.")
    duplicates: list[pinnjax.DataShape] = []
    for _ in range(times):
        ds = self.data_shape.clone(copy_split=copy_split)
        self.shapes.append(ds)
        duplicates.append(ds)
    return duplicates

Metrics on rows held out by portion (not in the main tabular pool).

If validation was deferred at construction, materializes it when deferred indices exist. If nothing was held out at construction (e.g. portion=1.0), logs a warning and returns {} — calling materialize_validation_from_portion cannot create rows after the fact.

With evaluation=None, builds a TabularPointwiseEvaluation and binds validation rows. If you pass an evaluation (e.g. the same TabularPointwiseEvaluation or another tabular subclass used during training), it is shallow-copied, .inputs and .truth are set to the validation arrays, then evaluate(model) is called so the original instance is unchanged.

def validate(
    self,
    model: pinnjax.NeuralNetwork,
    evaluation: pinnjax.Evaluation | None = None,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Metrics on rows held out by ``portion`` (not in the main tabular pool).

    If validation was deferred at construction, materializes it when deferred
    indices exist. If nothing was held out at construction (e.g. ``portion=1.0``),
    logs a warning and returns ``{}`` — calling
    [`materialize_validation_from_portion`][pinnjax.DataShape.materialize_validation_from_portion]
    cannot create rows after the fact.

    With ``evaluation=None``, builds a
    [`TabularPointwiseEvaluation`][pinnjax.TabularPointwiseEvaluation] and binds validation
    rows. If you pass an ``evaluation`` (e.g. the same
    [`TabularPointwiseEvaluation`][pinnjax.TabularPointwiseEvaluation] or another tabular
    subclass used during training), it is **shallow-copied**, ``.inputs`` and ``.truth`` are
    set to the validation arrays, then ``evaluate(model)`` is called so the original instance
    is unchanged.
    """
    from pinnjax.loss import TabularPointwiseEvaluation

    ds = self.data_shape
    if ds.validation_inputs is None and (
        ds._validation_indices is not None and ds._validation_indices.size > 0
    ):
        ds.materialize_validation_from_portion()
    if ds.validation_inputs is None or ds.validation_inputs.shape[0] == 0:
        config.LOGGER.warning(
            "All DATA was used in training/testing. Use a portion less than 1.0. "
            "Returning empty metrics.",
        )
        return {}
    if evaluation is None:
        evaluation = TabularPointwiseEvaluation()
        evaluation.bind_tabular_data(ds.validation_inputs, ds.validation_outputs)
    else:
        ev = copy.copy(evaluation)
        if not hasattr(ev, "inputs") or not hasattr(ev, "truth"):
            msg = (
                "When passing evaluation, it must have .inputs and .truth so "
                "validation rows can be bound (e.g. TabularPointwiseEvaluation or "
                "a tabular Evaluation with the same attributes)."
            )
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise TypeError(msg)
        ev.inputs = ds.validation_inputs
        ev.truth = ds.validation_outputs
        evaluation = ev
    metrics = evaluation.evaluate(model)
    return {k: float(v) for k, v in metrics.items()}

class SpatialGrid(Grid):
    """Base class for prediction grids"""

    AXIS_TO_IDX: ClassVar[Mapping[str, int]] = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}

    domain: pinnjax.SpatialDomain
    spatial_dimensions: int
    has_time: bool = False
    times: Array
    coordinates: Array
    spatiotemporal_coordinates: Array
    periodic: bool = False

    def _build_spatiotemporal_coordinates(self) -> None:
        """Build spatiotemporal coordinate mesh by adding
        time dimension to spatial coordinates"""
        if not self.has_time or self.times is None:
            msg = "Cannot build spatiotemporal coordinates without time configuration"
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise config.InputError(msg)

        spatial_shape = self.coordinates.shape  # e.g., (200, 300, 3) for 2D grid

        # Create time mesh: broadcast times to match spatial dimensions
        # Add singleton dimensions for all spatial dims, then broadcast
        time_shape = (self.num_times,) + (1,) * (len(spatial_shape) - 1) + (1,)
        times_mesh = jnp.broadcast_to(
            self.times.reshape(time_shape),
            (self.num_times, *spatial_shape[:-1], 1),
        )

        # Create spatial mesh
        spatial_mesh = jnp.broadcast_to(
            self.coordinates[None, ...],
            (self.num_times, *spatial_shape),
        )

        # Concatenate: [...spatial_dims, time]
        self.spatiotemporal_coordinates = jnp.concatenate(
            [spatial_mesh, times_mesh],
            axis=-1,
        )

    def _setup_temporal(self, time_range: tuple[float, float], num_times: int) -> None:
        """Setup temporal parameters and build spatiotemporal coordinates"""
        self.has_time = True
        self.time_range = time_range
        self.num_times = num_times
        self.times = jnp.linspace(time_range[0], time_range[1], num_times)
        self._build_spatiotemporal_coordinates()

    def _get_free_axes(
        self,
        fixed_coordinates: dict[str, float],
        expected_count: int,
    ) -> list[str]:
        """Determine which axes are free to vary"""
        coord_names = ["x", "y", "z"][: self.spatial_dimensions]
        free_axes = [ax for ax in coord_names if ax not in fixed_coordinates]

        if len(free_axes) != expected_count:
            msg = (
                f"Need exactly {expected_count} free axes,"
                f" got {len(free_axes)}: {free_axes}"
            )
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise config.InputError(msg)
        return free_axes

    def _build_coordinates(
        self,
        free_axes: list[str],
        fixed_coordinates: dict[str, float],
        num_points: tuple[int, ...],
    ) -> Array:
        """Build coordinate array from free and fixed axes"""
        # Create ranges for free axes
        ranges = []
        for i, axis in enumerate(free_axes):
            idx = self.AXIS_TO_IDX[axis]
            ranges.append(
                jnp.linspace(
                    self.domain.min[idx],
                    self.domain.max[idx],
                    num_points[i],
                    endpoint=not self.periodic,
                ),
            )

        # Create meshgrid for free axes
        mesh = [ranges[0]] if len(ranges) == 1 else jnp.meshgrid(*ranges, indexing="xy")

        # Build full coordinate array
        coordinates = []
        for axis in ["x", "y", "z"][: self.spatial_dimensions]:
            if axis in fixed_coordinates:
                fixed_val = fixed_coordinates[axis]
                coordinates.append(jnp.full_like(mesh[0], fixed_val))
            else:
                axis_idx = free_axes.index(axis)
                coordinates.append(mesh[axis_idx])

        return jnp.stack(coordinates, axis=-1)

    def slice(
        self,
        fixed_coordinates: dict[str, float] | None = None,
        *,
        atol: float = 1e-9,
    ) -> "pinnjax.SpatialComparisonGrid":
        fixed_coordinates = fixed_coordinates or {}

        coords_flat = self.coordinates.reshape(-1, self.spatial_dimensions)

        if not fixed_coordinates:
            return pinnjax.SpatialComparisonGrid(
                domain=self.domain,
                coords=coords_flat,
                fixed_coordinates=getattr(self, "fixed_coordinates", None),
            )

        valid_axes = set(["x", "y", "z"][: self.spatial_dimensions])
        bad = [k for k in fixed_coordinates.keys() if k not in valid_axes]
        if bad:
            msg = f"Invalid fixed axis/axes: {bad}. Valid: {sorted(valid_axes)}"
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise config.InputError(msg)

        mask = jnp.ones((coords_flat.shape[0],), dtype=bool)
        for axis, val in fixed_coordinates.items():
            idx = self.AXIS_TO_IDX[axis]
            mask = mask & jnp.isclose(
                coords_flat[:, idx], float(val), rtol=0.0, atol=atol
            )

        if not bool(jnp.any(mask)):
            msg = f"Slice produced no points for {fixed_coordinates}."
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        sliced_coords = coords_flat[mask, :]

        return pinnjax.SpatialComparisonGrid(
            domain=self.domain,
            coords=sliced_coords,
            fixed_coordinates=fixed_coordinates,
        )

class LineGrid(SpatialGrid):
    """1D line grid through domain"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        domain: pinnjax.SpatialDomain,
        fixed_coordinates: dict[str, float] | None = None,
        num_points: int = 100,
        axis: str | None = None,
        time_range: tuple[float, float] | None = None,
        num_times: int | None = None,
        *,
        periodic: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.domain = domain
        self.spatial_dimensions = len(domain.min)

        self.periodic = periodic
        self.fixed_coordinates = fixed_coordinates or {}
        self.num_points = (num_points,)

        if axis is None:
            free_axes = self._get_free_axes(self.fixed_coordinates, expected_count=1)
            self.free_axis = free_axes[0]
        else:
            self.free_axis = axis

        self.free_axes = [self.free_axis]

        # Build spatial coordinates
        self.coordinates = self._build_coordinates(
            self.free_axes,
            self.fixed_coordinates,
            self.num_points,
        )

        # Setup temporal dimension if specified
        if time_range is not None and num_times is not None:
            self._setup_temporal(time_range, num_times)

class SpatialComparisonGrid(SpatialGrid):
    # the purpose of this grid is to simply match the coordinates of a .csv
    # file with the ability to 'slice'.

    def __init__(
        self,
        domain: pinnjax.SpatialDomain,
        coords: Array,
        fixed_coordinates: dict[str, float] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.domain = domain
        self.spatial_dimensions = len(domain.min)
        self.fixed_coordinates = fixed_coordinates or {}

        unique_per_column = [
            jnp.sort(jnp.unique(coords[:, i])) for i in range(self.spatial_dimensions)
        ]

        # Apply fixed coordinates by masking the uniques
        self.column_values = []
        for i in range(self.spatial_dimensions):
            axis_name = list(SpatialGrid.AXIS_TO_IDX.keys())[i]  # "x", "y", "z", ...
            if axis_name in self.fixed_coordinates:
                # Only keep the fixed value
                # (match by tolerance so model float matches CSV)
                fixed_val = float(self.fixed_coordinates[axis_name])
                uniques = unique_per_column[i]
                close = jnp.isclose(uniques, fixed_val, rtol=0.0, atol=1e-9)
                if not jnp.any(close):
                    msg = f"Fixed coordinate {axis_name}={fixed_val} not in column {i}"
                    config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                # Use the CSV's value so scatter indexing matches
                self.column_values.append(jnp.array([uniques[jnp.argmax(close)]]))
            else:
                self.column_values.append(unique_per_column[i])

        # build the coordinate mesh
        if len(self.column_values) == 1:
            mesh = [self.column_values[0]]
        else:
            mesh = jnp.meshgrid(*self.column_values, indexing="xy")
        self.coordinates = jnp.stack(mesh, axis=-1)

    def shape(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
        # mesh shape (no time)
        return tuple(int(v.size) for v in self.column_values)

    def indices_for(self, coords: Array) -> list[Array]:
        n_spatial = self.coordinates.shape[-1]
        return [
            jnp.searchsorted(self.column_values[i], coords[:, i])
            for i in range(n_spatial)
        ]

    def add_time(
        self, times: Array, *, time_range: tuple[float, float] | None = None
    ) -> None:
        times = jnp.asarray(times, dtype=config.get_dtype()).reshape(-1)
        self.has_time = True
        self.times = times
        self.num_times = int(times.shape[0])
        self.time_range = time_range or (float(times.min()), float(times.max()))
        self._build_spatiotemporal_coordinates()

    def scatter(
        self,
        coords: Array,
        values: Array,
        *,
        require_full: bool = True,
    ) -> Array:
        # coords: (n_samples, n_spatial) in (x, y, [z]) column order
        n_spatial = self.coordinates.shape[-1]

        # indices along each axis as per column_values order: [x, y, (z)]
        idxs = self.indices_for(coords)

        # meshgrid(indexing="xy") => grid shape is (ny, nx, [nz]), i.e. Y first, then X
        if n_spatial >= TWO_DIMENSIONAL:
            shp = (
                int(self.column_values[1].size),  # ny
                int(self.column_values[0].size),  # nx
                *(int(v.size) for v in self.column_values[2:]),
            )  # [nz, ...]
            idxs = [idxs[1], idxs[0], *idxs[2:]]  # swap X<->Y for XY indexing
        else:
            shp = (int(self.column_values[0].size),)

        if require_full and int(coords.shape[0]) != int(jnp.prod(jnp.array(shp))):
            config.LOGGER.info(f"{coords.shape[0]=}")
            config.LOGGER.info(f"{int(jnp.prod(jnp.array(shp)))=}")
            msg = "CSV does not form a full Cartesian grid."
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        out = jnp.empty(shp, dtype=values.dtype)
        return out.at[tuple(idxs)].set(values)

class MorrisMethod(Sensitivity):
    def __init__(self, step_size: float = 0.25) -> None:
        if step_size <= 0.5:
            self.step_size = step_size
        else:
            msg = f"The step_size ({step_size}) is too LARGE for the Morris method."
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

        key, _ = jax.random.split(jax.random.key(config.get_seed()))
        self.key = key

        self.trajectories = None

    def sample(
        self,
        parameter_space: dict[
            str,
            tuple[ParamType, ContinuousRange | DiscreteRange],
        ],
    ) -> dict[str, jax.Array]:
        # sample in [0, 1] space

        out: dict[str, jax.Array] = {}
        _keys = jax.random.split(self.key, len(parameter_space) + 1)
        self.key, *subkeys = _keys
        for (name, _), key in zip(parameter_space.items(), subkeys, strict=False):
            out[name] = jax.random.uniform(key, ())  # default between 0 and 1
        return out

    def _trajectory(
        self,
        parameter_space: dict[
            str,
            tuple[ParamType, ContinuousRange | DiscreteRange],
        ],
    ) -> list[dict[str, jax.Array]]:
        parameters = list(parameter_space.keys())

        self.key, (subkey) = jax.random.split(self.key, 2)
        permutations = jax.random.permutation(subkey, jnp.arange(len(parameters)))

        old = self.sample(parameter_space)
        trajectory: list[dict[str, jax.Array]] = [old]
        for perm in permutations:
            parameter = parameters[int(perm)]
            new = dict(old)
            new[parameter] = self._step(parameter, current_location=old)
            trajectory.append(new)
            old = new

        return trajectory

    def _determine_delta_sign(self, value: jax.Array) -> float:
        if value + self.step_size <= 1.0:
            return 1.0
        if value - self.step_size >= 0.0:
            return -1.0
        return (
            -1.0 if value <= 0.5 else 1.0
        )  # if this case triggers, the step_size is too large

    def _step(
        self,
        parameter: str,
        current_location: dict[str, jax.Array],
    ) -> jax.Array:
        p = current_location[parameter]
        _sign = self._determine_delta_sign(p)

        return p + (_sign * self.step_size)

    def generate_trajectories(
        self,
        parameter_space: dict[
            str,
            tuple[ParamType, ContinuousRange | DiscreteRange],
        ],
        n: int = 15,
    ) -> list[list[dict[str, jax.Array]]]:
        trajectories: list[list[dict[str, jax.Array]]] = []
        i = 0
        while i < n:
            trajectories.append(self._trajectory(parameter_space))
            i += 1
        self.trajectories = trajectories
        return self.trajectories

    def to_real(
        self,
        parameter_space: dict[
            str,
            tuple[ParamType, ContinuousRange | DiscreteRange],
        ],
    ) -> list[list[dict[str, jax.Array]]]:
        real_trajectories: list[list[dict[str, jax.Array]]] = []
        for trajectory in self.trajectories:
            real_trajectory: list[dict[str, jax.Array]] = []
            for step in trajectory:
                _step: dict[str, jax.Array] = {}
                for name, value in step.items():
                    _step[name] = self.denormalize(name, value, parameter_space)
                real_trajectory.append(_step)
            real_trajectories.append(real_trajectory)
        return real_trajectories

    @staticmethod
    def normalize(value: jax.Array, low: jax.Array, high: jax.Array) -> jax.Array:
        return (value - low) / (high - low)

    @staticmethod
    def denormalize(
        name: str,
        norm_value: jax.Array,
        parameter_space: dict[
            str,
            tuple[ParamType, ContinuousRange | DiscreteRange],
        ],
    ) -> jax.Array:
        # convert from the normalized trajectories back into the initial values for use.

        def _denormalize_continuous(
            _norm_value: jax.Array,
            low: jax.Array,
            high: jax.Array,
        ) -> jax.Array:
            return low + _norm_value * (high - low)

        def _denormalize_log_continuous(
            _norm_value: jax.Array,
            low: jax.Array,
            high: jax.Array,
        ) -> jax.Array:
            return jnp.exp(jnp.log(low) + _norm_value * (jnp.log(high) - jnp.log(low)))

        def _denormalize_discrete(
            _norm_value: jax.Array,
            values: jax.Array,
        ) -> jax.Array:
            n = int(values.shape[0])
            idx = jnp.floor(_norm_value * n).astype(jnp.int32)
            idx = jnp.clip(idx, 0, n - 1)
            return values[idx]

        def _denormalize_category(
            _norm_value: jax.Array,
            values: jax.Array,
        ) -> jax.Array:
            n = int(values.shape[0])
            idx = jnp.floor(_norm_value * n).astype(jnp.int32)
            idx = jnp.clip(idx, 0, n - 1)
            return values[idx]

        (ptype, value) = parameter_space.get(name)
        denorm = None
        match ptype.lower():
            case "continuous":
                denorm = _denormalize_continuous(norm_value, *value)
            case "log-cont":
                denorm = _denormalize_log_continuous(norm_value, *value)
            case "discrete":
                denorm = _denormalize_discrete(norm_value, value)
            case "category":
                denorm = _denormalize_category(norm_value, value)
            case _:
                msg = f"Unknown parameter type: {ptype.lower()}"
                config.LOGGER.error(msg)
                raise ValueError(msg)

        return jnp.asarray(denorm)

        n = int(values.shape[0])
        idx = jnp.floor(_norm_value * n).astype(jnp.int32)
        idx = jnp.clip(idx, 0, n - 1)
        return values[idx]

    (ptype, value) = parameter_space.get(name)
    denorm = None
    match ptype.lower():
        case "continuous":
            denorm = _denormalize_continuous(norm_value, *value)
        case "log-cont":
            denorm = _denormalize_log_continuous(norm_value, *value)
        case "discrete":
            denorm = _denormalize_discrete(norm_value, value)
        case "category":
            denorm = _denormalize_category(norm_value, value)
        case _:
            msg = f"Unknown parameter type: {ptype.lower()}"
            config.LOGGER.error(msg)
            raise ValueError(msg)

    return jnp.asarray(denorm)

def generate_trajectories(
    self,
    parameter_space: dict[
        str,
        tuple[ParamType, ContinuousRange | DiscreteRange],
    ],
    n: int = 15,
) -> list[list[dict[str, jax.Array]]]:
    trajectories: list[list[dict[str, jax.Array]]] = []
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        trajectories.append(self._trajectory(parameter_space))

def sample(
    self,
    parameter_space: dict[
        str,
        tuple[ParamType, ContinuousRange | DiscreteRange],
    ],
) -> dict[str, jax.Array]:
    # sample in [0, 1] space

    out: dict[str, jax.Array] = {}
    _keys = jax.random.split(self.key, len(parameter_space) + 1)
    self.key, *subkeys = _keys
    for (name, _), key in zip(parameter_space.items(), subkeys, strict=False):
        out[name] = jax.random.uniform(key, ())  # default between 0 and 1
    return out

def to_real(
    self,
    parameter_space: dict[
        str,
        tuple[ParamType, ContinuousRange | DiscreteRange],
    ],
) -> list[list[dict[str, jax.Array]]]:
    real_trajectories: list[list[dict[str, jax.Array]]] = []
    for trajectory in self.trajectories:
        real_trajectory: list[dict[str, jax.Array]] = []
        for step in trajectory:
            _step: dict[str, jax.Array] = {}
            for name, value in step.items():
                _step[name] = self.denormalize(name, value, parameter_space)
            real_trajectory.append(_step)
        real_trajectories.append(real_trajectory)
    return real_trajectories

docs.title: PINN-JAX: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for JAX.
docs.text:
This package provides tools for defining, training, and evaluating physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) in Python using JAX.

Modules included:

  • config: Global constants and configuration parameters.
  • dataclass: Structured definitions for activations, paths, domains, materials, optimization, and training configurations.
  • distributions: Contains builders and containers for Scipy distributions.
  • experiment: ExperimentBuilder for managing and running PINN experiments.
  • geometry: Geometric primitives and domain shapes.
  • grid: Grid generation and comparison utilities.
  • importance: Sensitivity analysis tools, including MorrisMethod.
  • loss: Loss function definitions for boundary conditions, PDE residuals, and regularization.
  • model: Neural network architectures, constraints, transformations, and utilities.
  • pathing: Path definitions and generators for trajectories in the domain.
  • plot: Visualization functions for predictions, losses, and evolutions.
  • predict: Functions for predicting at times or along paths.
  • sampling: Sampling methods for domain points, e.g., SobolSampler.
  • storage: Model saving and loading utilities.
  • train: Training routines for PINNs.
  • utils: Helper functions for folder creation, path management, duration conversion, and other utilities.

Bases: Loss

Based on https://arxiv.org/pdf/2412.13993v2.

Combines the mean square error (MSE) and the standard deviation of squared residuals using a weighting factor alpha. Computed with jax.jit for efficiency.

\[ \text{Reg-RMSE} = \alpha \cdot \text{MSE} + (1-\alpha) \cdot \text{Std}(\hat{y}_i^2) \]

where \(\text{MSE} = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N} \hat{y}_i^2\) and \(\text{Std}(\hat{y}_i^2) = \sqrt{\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N} (\hat{y}_i^2 - \text{MSE})^2}\).

PARAMETER DESCRIPTION alpha

Weighting factor between 0 and 1. alpha=1 reduces to standard MSE.

TYPE: float | None DEFAULT: None

ATTRIBUTE DESCRIPTION complement_alpha

1 - alpha

TYPE: Array
